title: Global Supply Chain Policy & Development Lead
description:
Reporting to the Director of Global Supply Chain and sitting within DRC's FRISC/Supply Chain unit, this role leads policy & development for supply chain, with a focus on strengthening DRC's ability to develop, innovate, and deliver impactful supply chain outcomes. Operating as a strategic architect, you will design and implement forward-looking supply chain policies, governance, and processes that strengthen DRC's competitive advantage, operational excellence, and sector-wide impact, with a primary technical emphasis on procurement policy and governance, sourcing models, and category strategy development.

Your main duties and responsibilities will be:

  • Drive the organisation-wide procurement and supply chain development agenda, aligned with DRC's strategy, the humanitarian sector reform agenda, and the evolution from legacy to next-generation supply chain capabilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain global supply chain policies, quality standards, and governance frameworks, conducting periodic reviews and driving harmonisation of processes across operations

  • Act as Business Process Expert (BPE) for the Procure-to-Pay (P2Pay) process within DRC Dynamics 365, enabling digitalisation and process simplification across global supply chain systems.

  • Lead the development of organisation-wide category strategies anchored in data, supplier segmentation, and sector best practice, including sourcing models and consolidation opportunities

  • Establish performance frameworks, dashboards, and KPIs that translate supply chain policy, systems, and category strategy into measurable organisational value

  • Build organisational capability through training, coaching, and technical support, sharing evidence and lessons learned to advance sector-wide humanitarian supply chain excellence

  • Develop business cases and secure stakeholder alignment for strategic supply chain investments and system upgrades

  • Support Director of Supply Chain in strategic engagement with public and private sector partners, and initiating scalable pilots in logistics, technology, and financial services

 

About you

To be successful in this role we expect you to combine strong strategic & technical supply chain expertise with the ability to influence and drive change across a decentralised, multi-country organisation, translating policy and strategy into practical, adopted outcomes. Moreover, we also expect the following:

Required

  • 7-10 years' experience within one or more technical supply chain areas, preferably including policy development, strategy development, process optimisation and/or competency development

  • 3-5 years' experience with ERP systems and associated compliance monitoring

  • Demonstrated in-country & or Regional/HQ experience managing supply chain operations in developing country contexts with NGOs and/or the UN

  • Master's or equivalent relevant academic degree

  • Fluent English

Desirable

  • Danish, French, Spanish and/or Arabic language skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365
     

In this position, you are expected to demonstrate DRC’s five core competencies: 

Striving for excellence: You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process. 

Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback. 

Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation. 

Communicating: You listen and speak effectively and honestly. 

Demonstrating integrity: You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment.

 

We offer

Contract length: Permanent

Work location: Lyngbyvej 100, Copenhagen, Denmark

Start date: 1st September 2026

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with Danish Refugee Council’s agreement with the relevant union. Please refer to our website for more details. For questions regarding the vacancy please contact gaurav.verma@drc.ngo


Application process

All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Closing date for applications: 3rd August 2026

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo.

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

title: Product Quality & Configuration Engineer
description:
Description

We are seeking a driven Product Quality & Compliance Engineer to lead product quality, digital traceability and defence compliance across our R&D, production, and supplier ecosystem.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product development, quality, and compliance. Your focus will be on owning and embedding digital traceability across our R&D and production processes, ensuring quality, consistency, and transparency throughout the product lifecycle, while maintaining and continually improving our ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System (QMS).

You will be Quadsat’s core quality and compliance ambassador both internally and externally, working across R&D, Production, Supply Chain, Commercial, and with our customers to ensure our products meet the highest standards without compromising the agility and innovation that define Quadsat.

A key part of the role will be to build and own the practical configuration management and digital traceability system that connects engineering work, product releases, BOMs, SBOMs, verification evidence, production builds, defects, and delivered product configurations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving quality and compliance across our engineering and production ecosystem. On a day-to-day basis you can expect to:

  • Drive and govern product quality assurance from early concept and design stage through to verification, production, release and lifecycle support.

  • Build, own, and continuously improve Quadsat’s configuration management and digital traceability setup across tools such as Jira, Confluence, PDM, and production records, ensuring that product baselines, releases, BOMs, SBOMs, defects, deviations, and delivered product configurations are controlled and actively used.

  • Own the engineering governance and digital traceability framework in our Jira environment, including workflow and issue structures, traceability, dashboards, release planning and other related processes.

  • Support the R&D Director in managing development activities through Jira, ensuring that processes and requirements are effectively planned, tracked, and integrated into development and release workflows.

  • Coordinate development cycle reviews, compliance reporting, and engineering metrics using Jira data and provide insights to the R&D Director, developers and other stakeholders to enable informed quality-driven decision-making.

  • Coordinate internal and external product testing activities required to demonstrate product performance, quality, and compliance.

  • Lead compliance initiatives to prepare Quadsat's products and engineering processes for future qualification against defence and customer-specific standards, including frameworks such as MIL-STD, STANAG, AQAP, and DO-178, as required by our customers.

  • Maintain and continuously improve Quadsat's ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring effective governance, process maturity, and a culture of continuous improvement.

Skills & Experience

  • Educational background in engineering or technical field.

  • Proven experience working in a quality or compliance role, translating technical standards and compliance requirements into actionable engineering processes and development activities.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Solid understanding of risk management, DFMEA, requirements management, verification, validation, and test coverage methodologies.

  • You are a Jira super user with hands-on experience setting up and maintaining practical engineering governance, configuration management, release management, defect tracking, traceability, and compliance workflows in Jira or similar systems.

  • A pragmatic mindset that balances agility, engineering effectiveness, and defense-grade quality expectations.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

All candidates must be eligible to obtain security clearance with the Danish Defence and NATO authorities.

Our Dynamic Work Environment

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, pragmatic engineering, and people who want their work to have a lasting impact beyond individual projects.

About Quadsat

Quadsat develops and builds long-range electronic warfare payloads and software that support multi-domain military operations through fast and precise radio frequency detection and geolocation across the electromagnetic spectrum. Our technology enables defense organizations to maintain mission-critical connectivity, ensure resilient communication infrastructures, and achieve operational readiness.

Contact

For recruitment related questions please contact Aislinn Campbell, HR Director, by mail at afc@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 71 74 97 81.

title: Center for Engineering and Science ved Absalon søger en adjunkt eller lektor eller timelærere
description:
Føler du dig hjemme i grænselandet mellem robotteknologi, automation, maskinteknologi og Industri 4.0? Hvis ja skal du læse videre.

Er du drevet af at formidle og videregive din faglighed og erfaring?

Brænder du for at udvikle en ny uddannelse i tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, studerende og lokale virksomheder? Så kan det være dig, vi står og mangler til vores studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved efter- og videreuddannelsen i Automation og Drift.

Absalon etablerer september 2027 ny diplomingeniøruddannelse i Robotteknologi og automation. Diplomingeniøruddannelse i Robotteknologi og automation vil indgå i en tæt sammenhæng med diplomingeniøruddannelsen i Maskinteknologi og efter- og videreuddannelsen på akademiniveau i Automation og drift.

På ingeniøruddannelserne er det vores ambition at uddanne de bedste ingeniører i Danmark. Vi målretter vores uddannelse til arbejdsmarkedet ved at samarbejde tæt med den danske maskin-, automations- og procesindustri samt virksomheder og andre aktører i Biotekbyen Kalundborg og i Campus Kalundborgsamarbejdet, der bl.a. rykker ind i et nyt campusbyggeri i september 2028. Læs meget mere her. https://www.biotekbyen.dk/

Din profil
Vi søger en underviser, der brænder for at uddanne inden for grænseområdet mellem robotteknologi, automation, maskinteknologi og Industri 4.0. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i nedenstående:

Du er en dygtig og motiverende underviser, der er engageret i de studerende. Du bidrager sammen med dine kolleger til at skabe et aktivt, fagligt og socialt studiemiljø. Og det er vigtigt, at du kan bidrage positivt til den nære faglige relation, vi har mellem undervisere og studerende.

Du medvirker til at få det faglige, det praktiske og samarbejdet til at fungere godt. Vi er mere end en arbejdsplads, og vi drives af et stærkt kammeratskab og en fælles faglig interesse.

Du har lyst til at indgå i et arbejdsfællesskab og være med til at etablere en ny uddannelse. Vi opbygger og udvikler løbende vores ingeniøruddannelse, og meget skal gøres for første gang. Med den rette profil får du en central rolle i beskrivelsen og opbygningen af ny uddannelse med fokus på robotteknologi og automation Bl.a. skal vi i gang med at indrette og skaffe det rette udstyr til kommende robot- og automationslaboratorier.

Hvis du har indsigt i industriens behov for ingeniørkompetencer inden for robot og automationsområdet, vil det være en fordel.

Du har desuden nemt ved at indgå i dialog med virksomheder, både i forhold til muligheder for efter- og videreuddannelse og hvad angår samarbejde med studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne

Din ingeniørfaglighed kommer i spil i undervisningen, vejledningen og sparringen med kolleger inden for dele af følgende områder:
  • Integration og programmering af industrirobotter, f.eks. Universal robots, ABB, KUKA, FANUC
  • Siemens TIA-portal
  • Industrielle netværk
  • Vision-systemer og sensorteknologi
  • Safety-systemer og CE-mærkning
  • Integration af AI i robot- og automationsløsninger
  • PLC-, HMI- og SCADA-løsninger
  • CAD og 3D print
  • Teknisk dokumentation inden for maskin- og el-området.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har en baggrund som ingeniør og er gerne lektorbedømt
  • har relevant erhvervserfaring inden for ingeniørfaget
  • kan undervise på dansk og også gerne på engelsk.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved Automation og Drift har du en række forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsuge.

Undervise og projektvejlede de studerende. Du skal primært undervise og vejlede de studerende teoretisk og værksteds- og projektbaseret inden for dine fagområder. Du skal selv tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisningen og samtidig være med til løbende at udvikle undervisningen.

Undervise på efter- og videreuddannelse (EVU) og på grunduddannelse. Du skal undervise studerende på fuldtidsstudium såvel som kursister med et fuldtidsarbejde ved siden af deres uddannelse på EVU. Til undervisningen på EVU kan også knytte sig opgaver med opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder og præsentation af uddannelsesudbud.

Fagligt samarbejde som en del af hverdagen. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du sparrer og samarbejder med dine kolleger. Sammen sørger I f.eks. for at tilrettelægge gode undervisningsforløb, udvikle undervisningsmaterialer, og måske er der et arrangement tilknyttet centret, som skal stables på benene.

Har du erfaring med og interesse i enkelte administrative opgaver vil det være en fordel. Ligesom det vil være en fordel, hvis du har interesse i at spille en central rolle i etablering af ny uddannelse inden for robotteknologi.

Undervisningen på de forskellige uddannelsesudbud vil fortrinsvis være på vores Campus Kalundborg, men på EVU-området kan der forekomme undervisning på Absalons campus i Roskilde. Du skal være forberedt på, at noget undervisning kan foregå i weekend eller på aftener.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver ansat i Centre for Engineering and Science, som driver uddannelserne Bioanalytiker, Radiograf, Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi, Diplomingeniør i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelserne Diplomuddannelse i bioteknologi, Procesteknologi og kemi, Akademiuddannelse i Automation og Drift, samt Akademiuddannelse i Innovation, produkt og produktion.

Du bliver en del af et team med uddannelsesledere, adjunkter og lektorer. På vores uddannelser i Kalundborg er vi 20 ansatte undervisere, og ved Diplomingeniør i Maskinteknologi er vi fem lektorer og en adjunkt fast tilknyttet. Vi arbejder på at skabe den bedste ingeniøruddannelse i tæt samarbejde med biotekindustrien i Nordvestsjælland samt vores engagerede studerende. Vi værdsætter høj faglighed og løser opgaver samt udfordringer i fællesskab, hvor vi alle er bevidste om vigtigheden af at bidrage til fællesskabet og til centrets samlede målsætning.

Vi holder til i nybygget campusbygning fra 2021 og i nabobygningen Helix Lab. Fra 2028 vil vi være en del af nyt Campus Kalundborg-byggeri.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 41.232, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.537, - kr. inkl. pension. Der er mulighed for at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse pr. 1. oktober 2026, meget gerne før
  • Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Jesper Stensbo Knudsen, jesk@pha.dk, 7248 3224
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 14. august 2026
  • Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende, dog senest i uge 34 og 35.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

For stillingen gælder det, at du ansættes som adjunkt eller lektor alt efter dine kvalifikationer.

På Absalon er adjunkturet en 3-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og hvor alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

title: Professional Neapolitan Pizza Chef Wanted
description:
Full-Time Position | PizzaKlubben | Odder, Denmark

About Us
PizzaKlubben is an authentic Italian pizzeria located in Odder, just 20 minutes south of Aarhus, Denmark’s second-largest city.
Our passion is to serve authentic Italian pizza made with carefully selected ingredients, traditional techniques, and uncompromising attention to quality. We have built our reputation by delivering consistently high standards, and we are now looking for a skilled professional to join our team.

Website: http://www.pizzaklubbenodder.dk

Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Pizzaiolo who takes pride in producing authentic Italian pizza at the highest level.
This is not an entry-level position. We are only interested in candidates with genuine professional experience working in authentic Italian pizzerias.

The ideal candidate:
  • Has several years of professional experience as a Pizzaiolo.
  • Has leadership qualities and is comfortable taking responsibility in the kitchen.
  • Can stretch pizza dough quickly and consistently by hand.
  • Can confidently operate a professional Moretti Forni electric oven with a capacity of 9 pizzas.
  • Can produce a high volume of pizzas while maintaining excellent quality and consistency.
  • Works calmly and efficiently under pressure.
  • Is clean, organised, reliable, and passionate about authentic Italian pizza.

Important
We are looking for a true professional.
Unfortunately, in the past we have hired people who described themselves as experienced pizza chefs but were unable to perform at the level required in a professional Italian pizzeria.
For this reason, we will only consider applicants with proven professional experience and strong practical skills.

Please note that you must have a valid work permit for Denmark or be an EU/EEA, Nordic, or Swiss citizen to be considered for this position.

What We Offer
  • Permanent full-time position.
  • 32–37 working hours per week, spread across 5 working days.
  • Opportunity to work 6 days per week for candidates who wish to earn a higher salary.
  • Gross salary of approximately €3,500 per month (before tax), depending on experience and qualifications.
  • A fully furnished apartment ready for immediate move-in.

And assistance with:
  • CPR registration
  • Tax registration
  • Danish paperwork
  • Practical relocation support
  • Friendly international working environment.
  • Immediate start.

Denmark offers excellent working conditions, a high standard of living, and a healthy work-life balance.
We understand that relocating to another country is a big decision, and we will support you throughout the process. We assist with accommodation, CPR registration, tax registration, and other practical matters to make your transition as smooth as possible.

Your Workplace
You will become part of a professional team working with high-quality ingredients and modern equipment.
The kitchen is equipped with a Moretti Forni electric pizza oven with capacity for 9 pizzas at the same time, allowing efficient production while maintaining the highest standards of quality.

How to Apply
Please send:
  • Your CV.
  • Photos or videos of pizzas you have made.
  • Information about the restaurants where you have previously worked.
  • Your Instagram profile (if you have one).

This must be sent by email to: info@pizzaklubbenodder.dk
We review applications continuously and will close the position once the right candidate is found. We want this position to be filled as soon as possible, so do not hesitate to send your application if you think you could be a great fit.

Applicants who are shortlisted may also be asked to demonstrate their practical skills.
If you are a passionate professional Pizzaiolo who is ready for a new opportunity in Denmark, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Contact information:
info@pizzaklubbenodder.dk
+45 22 77 33 47

title: Sprechen Sie Deutsch und möchten Sie in Aarhus, Dänemark, arbeiten?

We are looking for a motivated and energetic Business Development Representative (BDR – Internal Sales) to join our team in Aarhus, Denmark. title: Team Leader – Night Shift Operations
description:

As our Night Shift Team Leader, you will be responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and operational management of our night shift operation, ensuring that customer deliveries are executed safely, efficiently, and on time.

title: 2 three-year postdocs in political communication and political psychology at Aarhus University
description:
The Department of Political Science, Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for two three-year full-time postdoctoral researchers to join the research project “The Politics of Shaming and Shamelessness: How Elite Rhetoric Fuels Hostility and Tolerance for Political Violence”, funded by the Carlsberg Foundation (Semper Ardens: Accelerate) and headed by Associate Professor Tobias Widmann. The starting date is flexible and subject to mutual agreement but expected to be between December 2026 and February 2027.

The project
Healthy political discourse is the lifeblood of democracy. Yet across Western democracies, discourse has grown markedly more hostile, and physical assaults on politicians, attacks on minorities, and mobs storming legislatures show how hostility increasingly spills over into political violence. The project examines how elites, through their rhetoric, contribute to this development. It focuses on the emotion of shame and two connected rhetorical practices that have been on the rise over the last decades: shaming, where elites publicly brand opponents as norm violators and threats to the moral fabric of society, and shamelessness, where elites reassure their supporters that stigmatized beliefs or behaviors are normal or even honorable. These practices do not merely express disagreement – they recalibrate what counts as legitimate behavior and instruct citizens on which actions should be punished or excused.

The project is organized around three work packages. Work package I develops computational tools to detect and quantify shaming and shamelessness in elite political discourse across advanced democracies. Work package II examines the causal consequences of elite shaming and shamelessness for citizens’ discursive norms, hostility in debate, and tolerance of political violence. Work package III develops and tests remedies against the harmful effects of this rhetoric, using generative agent-based simulations and AI-chatbot-based dialogue experiments.

The two postdocs advertised in this call will take on leading roles in the empirical work of the project, with different but complementary profiles. Both postdocs are expected to have an affinity to computational methods and tools. The project is funded by a Carlsberg Foundation Semper Ardens: Accelerate grant, an ambitious funding instrument supporting research of high international standing led by mid-career researchers. The project runs for four years from August 2026 to July 2030 and is carried out by a team of two postdocs and student assistants led by Associate Professor Tobias Widmann.

The positions
Postdoc 1 will focus on the development and application of computational tools in the project. This includes, first and foremost, computational text analysis to detect shaming and shamelessness in parliamentary debates, party manifestos, press releases, and elite social-media content. It also includes other forms of computational tools used in the project, such as generative agent-based simulations with LLM-powered agents and AI-chatbot-based dialogue interventions. The postdoc will lead the empirical work on work package I and contribute to the computational components of work packages II and III.

Postdoc 2 will focus on the experimental and quasi-experimental work of the project. This includes designing and implementing online and mock social-media experiments, developing causal identification strategies in observational data, and conducting human experiments with AI chatbots as adaptive dialogue interventions. The postdoc will lead the empirical work on work packages II and III, with a strong emphasis on research design and causal inference.

Both postdocs are expected to combine their respective methodological profiles with an active interest in computational tools. They will be part of a collaborative team including the PI and student assistants. Research will primarily be carried out in collaboration with other project members. In addition, the positions involve opportunities to pursue independent work within the overall focus of the project. The successful applicant will become part of an exciting and ambitious research project and a supportive research team with a collegial and respectful atmosphere. There will be excellent opportunities for intellectual development and mentoring, with a focus on how the candidate can make use of the postdoctoral position to develop their career.

In addition to the outlined research tasks, the position implies modest teaching obligations equivalent to one course per year.

Qualifications
Applicants must hold a PhD in political science or a closely related discipline (e.g., communication, sociology, computational social science, psychology) by the starting date of the position. We are looking for outstanding candidates who can demonstrate:

  • A strong record (relative to career stage) of research on political communication, political behavior, political psychology, or a closely related area.

  • An affinity to computational tools and methods, and strong programming skills (e.g., Python and/or R).

  • Familiarity with research on emotions, social norms, incivility, or political violence.

  • High level of professional English proficiency, both written and oral.

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international team.

  • Experience with or interest in comparative research across multiple democracies.


For Postdoc 1, we particularly look for:

  • Documented experience with computational text analysis, including natural language processing and the use of (multilingual) large language models / transformer-based models.

  • Experience with large-scale data collection (e.g., parliamentary speeches, manifestos, press releases, social-media data).

  • Interest in or experience with other computational tools relevant to the project, such as generative agent-based simulations or LLM-based conversational interventions.


For Postdoc 2, we particularly look for:

  • Documented experience with experimental and/or quasi-experimental research design.

  • Strong skills in statistical analysis and causal inference.

  • Experience with or demonstrated interest in LLM-based methods, including the use of conversational AI or generative agents in experimental settings.


Applicants are welcome to indicate whether they wish to be considered for one specific position or for both.

What we offer

  • A project that studies a highly relevant and societally important issue

  • A work environment at one of Europe’s leading political science departments with a vibrant, supportive, and collegial atmosphere

  • Excellent development opportunities and research support, including funding for data collection, conferences/travel, and research assistance

  • Competitive salary


Further information
For further information about the project and the positions, please contact Associate Professor Tobias Widmann at widmann@ps.au.dk.

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, don’t hesitate to contact HR coordinator Astrid Valdgård Schmidt at avs@au.dk.

Place of work
Department of Political Science, Bartholins Allé 7, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Application deadline
Applications must be submitted before the deadline of 31 August 2026. Candidates selected for interviews are expected to be contacted by the end of September.

Who we are
With around 130 academic staff members and 40 PhD students, the Department of Political Science is among Europe’s largest political science departments. The research at the department covers most political science disciplines, including public administration, and represents a variety of methodological approaches. We are among Europe’s highest-ranked departments, and our broad research profile enables us to focus on societal problems as they appear in the national and international political arena. This allows us to contribute actively to the development of the discipline. We offer a lively and ambitious research and teaching environment characterized by pluralism and openness. We expect active participation in the activities of the department, which includes being present at the department at least three days per week.

For more information about the Department of Political Science, please see here.

The Department of Political Science is part of Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University – a top 100 university. Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information here:
https://internationalstaff.au.dk/relocationservice/

Please find more information about research opportunities at Aarhus University here: http://international.au.dk/research/

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here:
http://talent.au.dk/junior-researcher-development-programme/

Terms of employment
The appointment is made in accordance with the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities as well as the circular on the Collective Agreement for Academics Employed by the State (in Danish).
The job content and qualification requirements are described in further detail in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Application procedure
When you apply for this position it is mandatory to attach the following:

  • Application

  • Curriculum Vitae. You are encouraged to declare any periods of leave without research activity, including, for example, maternity leave, since your research activities are assessed in relation to your actual research time

  • Education (diploma for master's, PhD and possibly higher doctoral degree)

  • List of publications (the enclosed publications must be clearly marked on the list of publications)

  • Publications. Up to three publications can be included in the application. In the event of several authors the publications must be accompanied by a co-author statement concerning the applicant's share of the collaborative work with the consent of the co-authors. This template may be used for the purpose

  • Teaching portfolio. The specific requirements regarding the documentation can be found here


Materials which cannot be uploaded together with the application may be submitted in three copies to Aarhus BSS HR & PhD, Aarhus University, Bartholins Allé 16, DK-8000 Aarhus C.

Read more about how to apply for an academic post at Aarhus BSS here

The evaluation process
After the application deadline, an assessment committee is appointed. Please note that the assessment of applicants is based solely on the material received prior to the application deadline. For further information, see Guidelines for Assessment Committee, Aarhus BSS.
Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.
The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Aarhus University
Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment to its 37,000 students (FTEs) and 8,700 employees and has an annual revenue of EUR 1.106 billion. title: PhD scholarship in AI-Driven Methods and Tools for Distributed Cyber-Physical Real-Time Systems - DTU Compute
description:
A PhD scholarship is available in the Embedded Systems Engineering section at DTU Compute.

The position is part of AI4SDV, a Chips Joint Undertaking project on AI-assisted methods and tools for software-defined vehicle (SDV) engineering automation. AI4SDV studies how AI can assist design, configuration, analysis, validation, and verification along the SDV engineering life cycle.

At DTU, we focus on AI-driven methods and tools for model-based systems engineering of distributed cyber-physical real-time systems. The PhD project will study methods that combine machine learning, combinatorial optimization, formal analysis, reinforcement learning, and large language models. We consider distributed architectures such as those found in vehicles, including Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) for in-vehicle communication and mixed-criticality applications that share hardware, network, and software resources.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your main task will be to develop AI-driven methods and prototype tools for analysis and configuration in model-based engineering workflows for distributed real-time systems. The exact PhD topic will be defined together with the supervisors. Relevant directions include:
  • AI-based methods that predict or approximate analysis results and then check the results with deterministic tools.
  • AI-assisted combinatorial optimization for configuration, mapping, scheduling, routing, or resource allocation problems.
  • LLM-based synthesis of models, constraints, test cases, and prototype code used by analysis and configuration tools.
  • Model-based workflows that connect requirements, architecture models, analysis artifacts, and generated configurations.

title: Cloud Engineer - build the infrastructure behind smarter hiring
description:
We want to change the way we recruit

Improve Business is a Copenhagen startup, four years young, on a mission to change the way companies and talent find each other. We believe hiring should be about matching people to roles on what they can actually do and what drives them, not just what fits on a CV.

Through Improve Business Academy, we work every day with skilled academics who are between jobs, helping them turn their expertise into real, hands-on experience with local companies. We've seen first-hand how much talent sits untapped in the pool of jobseekers, and we want to put our own belief into practice: so for this role, we're specifically looking for a registered jobseeker ready to build something that matters.

And we mean it when we say we hire differently: we weigh your motivation far more heavily than your CV. A great CV is welcome, but what we really want to understand is why you want this, how you think, and what you'd bring to the team.

Because that's exactly what this is. We're building a new recruitment-matching platform, and you'll help shape its foundation from the earliest days. We're small, ambitious, and moving fast, which means the work you do here is visible, it ships, and it counts. You won't be maintenance number seven on a legacy system; you'll be right at the core, based in our office on Gothersgade in the heart of Copenhagen.

One important note: it is important for us to hire unemployed for this position, so you'll need to be a registered jobseeker. If that's not you, this particular role won't be the right fit - but do keep an eye on us, as we're growing.

The role

We're looking for a Cloud Engineer to help develop and maintain our recruitment-matching platform, which runs entirely on Microsoft Azure for now. You'll work hands-on with Azure Container Apps, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Service Bus, Azure Container Registry, Key Vault, and Static Web Apps, all provisioned through infrastructure as code using Bicep.

You'll own the reliability of our CI/CD pipelines and quality gates, which enforce linting, static typing, security scanning, and a strict test coverage floor. Practical experience with automated delivery and release safety in containerized environments is essential, and Docker is required.

Observability is a core part of this role. Our backend already ships structured JSON logging with request correlation IDs and separate liveness and readiness probes, and we'll look to you to extend this foundation with OpenTelemetry instrumentation. You should be proficient with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics to build the dashboards and alerts that keep us ahead of problems.

To collaborate effectively with the team, you'll need enough backend fluency to discuss and touch the codebase: Python, FastAPI, SQL, Pydantic, and Alembic-managed database migrations on PostgreSQL with pgvector for vector search. Our matching engine relies on an asynchronous scoring worker that consumes a Service Bus queue and computes embeddings with the machine learning model, so understanding the operational realities of ML workloads in production will be part of your daily conversations.

Nice to have

Experience with Kubernetes, or with application security practices such as session management, multi-tenancy isolation, and OAuth integrations, is a strong plus.

Above all, we value engineers who treat reliability, observability, and cost awareness as product features rather than afterthoughts.

The details

  • Contract: 6-month position to start, with the genuine possibility of a permanent role.

  • Location: On-site at our office on Gothersgade, Copenhagen.

  • Requirement: You'll need to be based in or near Copenhagen.

  • Profile: We welcome international candidates - our working language is English

  • We'll be holding interviews in weeks 32 and 33, and we hope you can start on 1 September.

Sound like you?

If you read the tech stack above and felt at home, we'd love to hear from you. We'd love to see your CV, but don't spend time polishing it. Instead, tell us what motivates you, why this role speaks to you, and about a project you're genuinely proud of. We care far more about your motivation and how you think than about a perfect CV.

Send your application to our CEO, Anne Hørsted, at anne@improvebusiness.dk. Deadline is August 4.

Please note that we're on summer holiday from 10–27 July. After that, you're also welcome to call us with any questions on +45 30 14 16 14 and ask for our Data Scientist, Ramon Souza.

title: PhD scholarship in CFD and System Analysis of an Integrable Calcination Technology for CO2 Capture in Cement Production - DTU Chemical Engineering
description:
Are you motivated to develop advanced modelling tools for the green transition of one of the world’s most CO₂-intensive industries?

This PhD position offers an opportunity to work at the interface of computational fluid dynamics (CFD), high-temperature process engineering, carbon capture, and sustainability analysis for cement production.

You will contribute to the INNO-CCUS-funded CAP-FLEX project, which aims to develop a novel calcination technology that can be integrated into existing cement plants to produce a concentrated CO₂ stream from cement raw meal. The technology builds on the pulse-fluidized FUELFLEX(r) Pyrolyser developed by Fuller Technologies and combines flexible heat input from electric heating and oxyfuel combustion.

The PhD project is a collaboration between DTU Chemical Engineering, DTU Sustain, Fuller Technologies, and other project partners. It covers two connected modelling tracks: CFD/process modelling anchored at DTU Chemical Engineering and system/sustainability modelling in collaboration with DTU Sustain. The CFD model will describe gas–solid flow, heat transfer, combustion, and calcination, while the system model will assess environmental, economic, and societal implications.

You will develop and validate CFD and engineering models using experimental, pilot-scale, and industrial data generated in the project. You will also be involved in data collection and analysis. The models will support process design, operation, optimization, and scale-up of the calcination technology, and contribute to life cycle assessment, techno-economic assessment, and broader system analysis.

You will join an interdisciplinary and industry-oriented research environment with close interaction between academic and industrial partners. The project combines fundamental modelling, experimental validation, sustainability assessment, and industrial scale-up, giving you a strong platform to develop scientific and applied competences in sustainable high-temperature processes, carbon capture technologies, and system analysis for the green transition.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall responsibility will be to develop CFD and system modelling tools to support the design, optimization, scale-up, and sustainability assessment of a novel calcination technology for CO₂ capture in cement production.

Your primary tasks will include:
  • Develop and validate CFD models for gas–solid flow, heat transfer, oxyfuel combustion, electric heating, and calcination
  • Use CFD and engineering models to analyze key process parameters and support process design, operation, optimization, and scale-up
  • Contribute to system-level assessment of the technology, including life cycle assessment, techno-economic assessment, and sustainability analysis
  • Publish results in scientific journals and present your work at project meetings and international conferences

We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a background in chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, energy engineering, process engineering or a related field.

Experience with one or more of the following areas will be an advantage:
  • CFD modelling of multiphase reactive flows
  • High-temperature processes, combustion, calcination, cement production, or carbon capture
  • Life cycle assessment, techno-economic assessment, system analysis, or sustainability assessment

You should be able to work independently and collaborate effectively with academic and industrial partners. Good written and spoken English skills are required.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

title: PhD scholarship in Fast-Tracking Innovation through Technology Implementation - DTU Engineering Technology
description:
If you are passionate about innovation and technology and wish to contribute to developing knowledge, methods, and tools that will help companies, organisations and society, join us for a PhD project at DTU Engineering Technology. You will work at the intersection between research and industry in an application-focused environment and influence how technology succeeds in practice by focusing on technology implementation in Danish SMEs.

The PhD project will study how SMEs transition through technology implementation towards structured innovation processes, e.g. to fasten the time-to-market of new products. When SMEs become established and implement new technology, they often transition from being agile, customer centric and entrepreneurial to more structured and focused on internal processes. In doing so, they lose the startup approach, which results in longer time-to-market for new products.

The project will follow the journey of navigating the complexity of technology implementation in multiple Danish SMEs over time, and the successful candidate will define and pursue a research project within this frame. Relevant perspectives include innovation management, technology implementation, human-centred design, and organisational management. The project is expected to combine rigorous empirical research with the development and evaluation of new approaches, contributing both to academic knowledge and to the advancement of educational practices at DTU.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall focus will be to develop and conduct research on SMEs transitions through technology implementation towards structured innovation processes. You will contribute to both research and teaching activities within DTU Engineering Technology.

Your primary tasks will be to:
  • Develop and execute an independent PhD research project within technology implementation
  • Study the impact of organizational and contextual changes on technology implementation outcomes within the context of Danish SMEs
  • Design and evaluate a practice-based toolset define the combinations of methods and tools for technology implementation
  • Collect and analyse empirical data using qualitative and/or quantitative methods
  • Publish research findings in high-quality academic journals and conferences
  • Contribute to teaching, supervision, and development of courses and learning activities
  • Collaborate with colleagues and partners across DTU Engineering Technology

The ideal candidate has an educational background relevant to innovation management, technology implementation or organisational management. Applicants must be fluent in English and Danish.

title: Business Developer
description:
Commercial decisions are only as good as the insights behind them. At SELECTED, we're building a new Business Development team to help our markets make even better commercial decisions.

As one of the first members of the team, you'll work at the intersection of business and data. Together with commercial stakeholders across Europe, you'll turn insights into action and help shape how commercial decisions are made.

YOUR TEAM
You will join a newly established Business Development team at SELECTED. Together, we work to strengthen commercial decision-making by connecting business understanding, data and technology. Joining us from at an early stage, you'll have the opportunity to influence how we work, build strong relationships across the organisation and make an impact from day one.
Working closely with Country Sales Managers, Sales Representatives, Merchandise Managers and Partner Performance Managers across our European markets, you'll help shape how data creates value in the business. You'll also collaborate with colleagues in our buying organisation as well as BESTSELLER Tech to develop commercial data products that support our decision-making across the value chain.

YOUR ROLE
You'll help strengthen commercial decision-making across SELECTED by combining business understanding with data. Working closely with colleagues across our sales organisation and markets, you'll identify opportunities, develop tools and analyses and help colleagues make better and faster decisions across our markets.

More specifically, you will:

  • Analyse commercial performance across partners and markets to identify opportunities and recommend where actions will create the greatest value

  • Develop tools, analyses and AI-supported solutions that help our sales organisation make better and faster commercial decisions

  • Drive the adoption of data-driven ways of working through stakeholder engagement, collaboration and training

  • Support our buying organisation by bringing commercial insights into product-related decisions and processes

  • Collaborate with BESTSELLER Tech to shape and continuously improve commercial data products that create value across the business.

YOUR BENEFITS
This isn't a role where insights disappear into a report. You'll work closely with the people making commercial decisions, giving you the opportunity to challenge, advise and see the impact of your work first-hand. You'll also:

  • Help build a new function with room to influence priorities and ways of working

  • Work closely with commercial stakeholders across Europe, our buying organisation and BESTSELLER Tech

  • Benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home, which is a natural part of how we work at SELECTED.

YOUR PROFILE
You're curious about what drives commercial performance and motivated by making a real impact through data. You enjoy navigating between business and analytics, and you're at your best when collaborating with others to solve complex commercial challenges. 

In addition, we imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant Master's degree, for example within Economics and Business Administration (cand.merc.), Business Intelligence or Data Science, or a similar field

  • Have experience working with commercial data and business insights, ideally within fashion, wholesale, retail or a comparable industry

  • Understand how commercial performance, partner dynamics and product decisions influence business results

  • Are comfortable working with analytical tools such as SQL, Python or similar, and enjoy using modern technologies, including AI, to develop analyses and practical solutions

  • Communicate complex insights in a simple and actionable way to stakeholders with different backgrounds

  • Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Business Development Manager Alex Brink Poulsen. Otherwise, send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 4 August 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting when we find the right candidate.

title: Drone Technician
description:
Drone Technician

Reblade ApS – Denmark

Danish Award-Winning Team and Technology

Reblade is a Danish deep-tech startup founded in 2020, developing autonomous drone systems

for wind turbine blade repair. We combine robotics, UAV technology, computer vision,

advanced sensors, and software to automate one of the most challenging maintenance tasks in the

renewable energy industry.

Our multidisciplinary team consists of highly skilled engineers within robotics, software,

electronics, mechanical engineering, and computer vision. We have several PhDs, post-docs, and

a professor on the team, and our international culture is built around innovation, technical

excellence, and collaboration.

As recipients of multiple European innovation awards and funding programs, we are rapidly

growing our engineering organization and are looking for talented people who want to develop

cutting-edge technology with real-world impact.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Drone Technician to join our hardware team in Denmark.

You will play a key role in preparing, assembling, maintaining, and testing our UAV systems,

ensuring they are ready for laboratory development, field testing, and customer demonstrations.

Working closely with software, electronics, and mechanical engineers, you will help ensure our

systems operate safely and reliably.

Responsibilities

• Assemble, configure, and maintain UAV systems and payloads.

• Perform preventive maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting of drones and supporting

equipment.

• Prepare drones and equipment for laboratory testing, field deployments, and customer

demonstrations.

• Perform pre-flight and post-flight inspections.

• Manage batteries, charging systems, spare parts, tools, and workshop inventory.

• Support flight testing and operational deployments.

• Document maintenance activities, inspections, and technical findings.• Contribute to the continuous improvement of assembly, maintenance, and testing

procedures.

Requirements

Essential

• Technical education within electronics, mechanics, aviation, mechatronics, or a related

technical field.

• Hands-on experience assembling and maintaining UAVs or similar electromechanical

systems.

• Experience with commercial or industrial UAV operations.

• Minimum 100 documented flight hours operating medium or large UAVs.

• Valid EU Remote Pilot Certificates A1/A3 and A2.

• Strong troubleshooting and practical problem-solving skills.

• Ability to read technical documentation and follow assembly procedures.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused approach.

• Good English communication skills.

• Willingness to relocate to Denmark.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with ArduPilot or similar flight control systems.

• Experience supporting UAV testing and customer demonstrations.

• Experience working in robotics, prototype development, or R&D environments.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work with cutting-edge autonomous drone technology.

• Be part of an award-winning international engineering team.

• High level of responsibility and technical ownership.

• Fast-paced startup environment where your work has immediate impact.

Location

Denmark (On-site)Employment Type

Full-time

Join us in shaping the future of autonomous wind turbine blade maintenance through

robotics and drone technology.

description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen

title: Circle K Århusvej i Randers søger en sælger på 20 timer
description:
Kære fremtidige kollega  

Først og fremmest, lad os starte med at sige, at et job som Sælger hos Circle K ikke er for alle. Men det er et job der passer til mange, og måske også dig?  

At arbejde som sælger på Circle K er ikke som ethvert sælgerjob. Os der arbejder her er vilde med det, og spørger du en af vores uundværlige sælgere om hvorfor, vil de bla nævne: Selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og ansvar.  

  

Vi leder efter en positiv teamplayer som:  

  

  • Har en sælger gemt I sig, motiveres af salg og kan levere en service lidt ud over det sædvanlige  

  • Kan bevare overblikket og humøret, når der kommer uforudsete udfordringer ind af døren, og formår at løse dem med sund fornuft. Også selvom der er lang kø  

  • Har en interesse for at tilberede mad. For vi elsker det! Og vi ser derfor gerne, at du har lyst til, at lave de lækreste sandwich og de bedste burgere.  

  • Forstår vigtigheden af, at vores kunder får den bedste oplevelse når de besøger os. Dette indebærer også at butikken, kundetoilet og forplads er ren og pæn.   

  • Du forstår betydningen af, at arbejde i et team, hvor alle er afhængige af- og stoler på, at hver løfter sit. Og til tider er villig til at give lidt ekstra.  

  

Hvad kan I tilbyde mig?  

  

Vi er en dynamisk, handlingsorienteret organisation, hvor vi arbejder sammen som ét team. Vi tager ikke os selv alt for højtideligt og engagerer os ikke i politik eller bureaukrati. Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på.  

Udover helt unikke udviklingsmuligheder, tilbyder vi et job med yderst attraktive fordele og personalegoder. Som en del af vores Circle K familie vil du bla få medarbejderrabat på brændstof, bilvask samt på mad og drikkevarer i vores butikker. Derudover tilbyder vi:  

  • En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring  

  • Fordelagtige lønninger og forskudttidstillæg 

  • Og ikke mindst, Danmarks bedste kollegaer  
     

Mange der i dag driver vores stationer eller arbejder på vores kontor, startede deres karriere som sælgere på stationen, måske var tanken bare at blive hos os et stykke tid, men det var begyndelsen på en lang karriere! Og for dig der har andre mål og drømme i din karriere, er Circle K et fantastisk sted til at få erfaring, der er værd at tage med sig videre i arbejdslivet. 

Så hvis du vil have et job, hvor du kan være med til at give vores kunder den bedste oplevelse, udvikle dig og blive en del af et fantastisk team på Circle K Randers, så er det nu du skal sende din ansøgning afsted.

Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Store Manager Kathe Maria Sagatume på tlf nr.: 86133101

Antal timer:

Ca. 20 timer ugentligt. Vagterne ligger både på hverdage og i weekender, morgen, eftermiddag og aften. Arbejdstiden er placeret på tidspunkter, der gør stillingen uegnet som studiejob. Det er en forudsætning for at komme i betragtning til stillingen, at du er fyldt 18 år. 

Ansøgningsfrist og tiltrædelse: 

Løbende 

Som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen, indhenter vi referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgivere.

Hos os behøver du, hverken CV eller ansøgning for at søge job. Når du trykker på ”ansøg nu” kommer du til en portal, hvor du skal svare på nogle spørgsmål om forskellige arbejdssituationer, som samtidig giver dig et indblik i, hvordan det er at arbejde i Circle K.  

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Hos Circle K er der plads til alle og vi arbejder altid sammen som One team! Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på. Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge stillingen – uanset alder, køn, religion, handicap, etnisk baggrund etc.

Benediktegården er en integreret institution med ca. 114 børn fordelt på 4 vuggestuegrupper og 3 børnehavegrupper. Vi er en del af den selvejende klynge Prinsessegårdene, hvor vi samarbejder tæt om kvalitet, udvikling og trivsel.

Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper til vores børnehave på 32-37 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse den 1. september 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Hos os bliver du en del af et hus med høj faglighed, stærkt sammenhold og masser af smil i hverdagen. Vi er tre/fire voksne på hver stue, så du vil altid have erfarne kolleger omkring dig, som hjælper dig godt i gang.

Du behøver ikke have mange års erfaring – måske er det dit første job i en daginstitution, eller måske har du arbejdet med børn på anden vis. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at være en nærværende voksen og bidrage til en tryg og sjov hverdag for børnene.

Vi håber, at du:
  • har lyst til at være sammen med børn og deltage aktivt i deres hverdag
  • er nysgerrig, mødestabil og tager ansvar
  • møder børn, forældre og kolleger med smil og respekt
  • har lyst til at lære og udvikle dig sammen med dygtige kolleger
  • bidrager til et godt fællesskab og en positiv stemning

Hos os får du:
  • en grundig introduktion og kolleger, der hjælper dig godt i gang
  • mulighed for at udvikle dig og få erfaring med pædagogisk arbejde
  • mulighed for 4-dages arbejdsuge
  • et hus med høj faglighed, godt kollegaskab og masser af grin
  • et mangfoldigt fællesskab blandt både børn og medarbejdere
  • et tæt samarbejde med Statens Museum for Kunst, hvor vi besøger museet, oplever kunst og arbejder i deres værksteder
  • betalt sundhedsforsikring
  • store legepladser, køkkenhave, et kommende udeværksted og skønne grønne omgivelser med Valbyparken og Karens Minde lige i nærheden

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV snarest muligt – vi holder samtaler løbende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – uanset om du har erfaring eller er klar til at tage de første skridt ind i det pædagogiske arbejde.

title: Søges: To medarbejdere til vores rengøringsteam, Middelfart, Denmark
description:
Rengøringsmedarbejder hos Noordwind Galsklint Strand Camping.

Er du vild med camping, naturen og at omgås mennesker? Har du sans for struktur og kan du godt lide at give en hånd med? Vi søger to personer, der sammen som et fast team står for rengøringen og deler arbejdet ligeligt mellem sig – så er du måske lige den rette til at styrke os.

Dine opgaver:

  • Rengøring af sanitetsområder, køkkener, receptionen og butikken
  • Rengøring af hytterne, når gæsterne er tjekket ud
  • Påfyldning af forbrugsartikler
  • Overvågning af forbruget og indberetning ved mangler
  • Indberetning af defekter eller ønsker om ændringer i arbejdsgange, materialer osv.
  • Støtte til pladslederen
  • Mulighed for flere arbejdstimer:
  • Hvis du ønsker det, kan du påtage dig yderligere opgaver – i så fald øger vi det ugentlige timetal eller din løn tilsvarende.


Vi forventer, at du:

  • taler dansk eller engelsk
  • er venlig, selvstændig og serviceorienteret
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for rengøringsbranchen.


Det tilbyder vi:

  • En fast plads i et team på to, der deler arbejdet ligeligt – I skiftes til vagterne og holder altid fri på skift
  • Fast gennemsnitlig ugentlig arbejdstid med timekonto: i gennemsnit ca. 10 timer om ugen pr. person – mest i højsæsonen (juli–august, op til ca. 20 timer/uge), mindre om vinteren (ca. 3 timer/uge), når I tager ferie og udnytter kompensationsfrihed. Efter aftale kan I øge jeres timetal ved at påtage jer yderligere opgaver.
  • Helårsstilling – pladsen har åbent hele året (om vinteren i mindre omfang)
  • Nyd naturen, når vagten er slut, her på vores campingplads
  • Arbejdstider: i højsæsonen alle ugens dage og ellers efter aftale
  • Et imødekommende team og en arbejdsplads midt i naturen.

simon.kilimann@noordwind.eu

Hos “Noordwind” elsker vi naturen og de oplevelser, den giver – uanset om det er i eksklusive ferielejligheder eller i et telt på en campingplads. Vi står for moderne, naturnære og afslappede ferieoplevelser, som vi hele tiden udvikler og fornyer.

title: Pædagog og afdelingsleder
employer: S/I Solhjem, Rudolf Steiner Vuggestue og Børnehave
description:
GENOPSLAG

 

Solhjem søger pædagog og afdelingsleder

 

Pr. 1. september 2026 søger vi en pædagog og afdelingsleder til vores Børnehavehus. Stillingen er på 37 timer, heraf 10 timer afsat til ledelsesopgaver. Børnehavehuset er den største af Solhjems afdelinger og består af tre børnegrupper på hver omkring 20 børn. Der er et tæt samarbejde grupperne imellem.

 

Som afdelingsleder har du ansvaret for det pædagogiske arbejde i afdelingen samt for praktisk koordinering og personaleledelse. Du indgår desuden i Solhjems ledelsesteam sammen med 3 øvrige afdelingsledere og Solhjems leder. Ledelsesteamet har faste ugentlige møder.

Til daglig er du tilknyttet én af børnegrupperne som pædagog og indgår dér i et tæt samarbejde med børnegruppens anden pædagog samt en pædagogisk medhjælper.

 

Solhjem er et Rudolf Steiner dagtilbud, hvor vi har børn i alderen 1 – 6 år. Vi har 4 forskellige afdelinger: Børnehavehuset, Vuggestuen, den fuldintegrerede afdeling Vildrosen samt vores skovbørnehave Brumbasserne. Sammenlagt har vi plads til 146 børn, når vi er flest. Solhjem ligger ved skov og strand med Rudolf Steiner Skolen som nærmeste nabo.

I vores pædagogiske praksis lægger vi vægt på at skabe en tryg og genkendelig hverdag for alle børn. Vi arbejder ud fra en oplevelsesorienteret og kunstnerisk tilgang til pædagogikken, og vi værdsætter livet udenfor på alle årstider.  
Vi er et engageret kollegialt fællesskab med højt til loftet og begejstring for det pædagogiske arbejde. Vi er optaget af faglig udveksling og udvikling, som vi glæder os til at dele med vores nye afdelingsleder i Børnehavehuset.

 

I ansættelsen prioriterer vi kandidater med følgende kompetencer:

  • Du har erfaring indenfor målgruppen 3 – 6 år

  • Du har erfaring med ledelse af pædagogisk praksis

  • Du har erfaring med eller interesse for steinerpædagogik

  • Du har kommunikative kompetencer både skriftligt og mundtligt

  • Du har et godt overblik og sans for praktisk koordinering

  • Du har erfaring med administrative opgaver (skemalægning, vikardækning, korrespondancer mv.)

  • Du har lyst til og forudsætninger for at indgå i Solhjems pædagogiske ledelse

 


Se i øvrigt vores hjemmeside: www.solhjem-aarhus.dk

For yderligere oplysninger: Tina Lauritsen, leder, på tlf. 26 19 82 95.

 

Send din ansøgning på mail til post@solhjem-aarhus.dk.

Ansøgningsfrist d. 3. august 2026 kl. 12. Tiltrædelse 1. september eller snarest derefter.

title: Køkkenassistent, kok, delikatesseslagter eller lignende med sans for gode råvarer og smagfulde retter søges
description:
Vi tilbyder:
Et spændende job på en efterskole, hvor du får en udfordrende og afvekslende arbejdsdag. For at lykkes i jobbet, skal du kunne samarbejde, trives med en travl hverdag, hvor skolens elever hjælper til i køkkenet. Vi vægter, at madlavningen er baseret på friske og delvist økologiske råvarer, samt at mest mulig mad er produceret fra bunden.  På Blåkilde Efterskole arbejder vi på at gøre skolens drift mere bæredygtig - også i køkkenet ;-)

 

Om dig:

Du finder glæde i at udfordre elevernes smagsløg med nærende og spændende mad. Du finder energi i et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor arbejdsdagen er præget af variation, højt tempo, god musik og dejlige efterskoleelever. For en del elever er det nyt at hjælpe til i køkkenet og de har brug for ekstra hjælp, og derfor skal du være tålmodig og indstillet på at sige tingene flere gange.

 

Personlige og faglige kompetencer:

·     Du motiveres af din nysgerrighed på råvarer og vil gerne tænke nyt

·     Du nyder at lave maden helt fra bunden og går op i smagfulde retter

·     Du er holdspiller, da du bliver en del af et team på 4 ansatte i køkkenet

·     Du er imødekommende og kan lide at arbejde med unge mennesker

·     Du kan arbejde selvstændigt, effektivt og fokuseret

·     Du kan håndtere pres og har et godt overblik

·     Du er fleksibel, da arbejdstiden varierer

Ansættelse: fra 1. oktober 2026 på ca. 32 timer/uge, fordelt over dag-, aften- og weekendvagter.

title: Autolakerer til Århus
description:
Autolakerer søges til at få lakken til at skinne igen! 

Er du den, der får et tilfredsstillende sug i maven, når en bil forlader kabinen med en spejlblank finish? Elsker du duften af frisk lak og præcision i hver eneste sprøjtning? Så er det dig, vi leder efter!

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året.

Hvad skal du lave?

Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Ansvarsområde er kabinen og du skal være med til at sikre den daglig drift i kabinen.
  • Sikre jævnt flow, korrekt farvematch og en finish, der spiller.
  • Selvom du har et medansvar for kabinen, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det.
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens.

Hvem er du?

Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har erfaring med sprøjtelakering – enten som udlært autolakerer eller med solid erfaring.
  • Går op i kvalitet og finish – du lakerer ikke bare, du skaber mesterværker.
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver
  • Har B-kørekort – så bilerne ikke kun ser flotte ud, men også kan flyttes.
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens.

Hvad får du?

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi ved, hvad dygtige folk er værd!
  • Gode kollegaer, der deler din passion for lakering og håndværk.
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med
  • Mulighed for udvikling
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med humor og højt til loftet.
  • Overenskomst, pension og de fordele, du fortjener.

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige lakmester med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette.

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme. 

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Susanne Damgaard Petersen på 30432854
