title: Re-announcement: PhD Positions in Bio-Inspired Flying Robot Design for Powerline Inspection
description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is reannouncing 2 of 3 PhD positions in the area of digital and embedded electronics, energy harvesting, and bioinspired design for flying robotic technologies. The starting date is as soon as possible and will be agreed with the successful candidates.    

The section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare. 

The section is a vital component of our educational programs in electrical engineering in Odense, offering Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering.  Over the next few years, the section is expected to expand to include at least 30 academics, including PhD students and engineers, to support research funding, industrial collaboration, and educational activities. This growth will enable the section to continue its contribution to the field of electrical engineering and related areas. 

The SDU campus in Odense comprises five faculties and soon also a large university hospital creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community and highly livable with a green banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas. 

 

Job Description

We are seeking highly motivated PhD candidates to join the Carlsberg Accomplish, FreeFly project, an ambitious research project focused on developing a birdlike flying robot for autonomous powerline inspection. Two distinct PhD positions remain available: 

PhD 1 – Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots 

You will investigate, analyze, and design novel energy-harvesting techniques that enable soft aerial robots to power their flight using the strong magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage powerlines. Your work will contribute to creating self-sustaining robotic systems capable of infinite flight missions. 

 

PhD 2 – AI-Driven Navigation and Control for Aerial Robots 

You will design and develop advanced navigation, control, and decision-making systems for aerial robots using state-of-the-art AI-methods. This includes exploring spiking neural networks accelerated by FPGA/MPSoC platforms to meet real-time robotics requirements. Your research will advance the autonomous capabilities of our self-recharging inspection drones. 

 

General Responsibilities 

As a PhD student on this project, you will: 

  • Conduct cutting-edge research contributing to the development of a birdlike autonomous flying robot for powerline inspection. 

  • Participate in teaching activities, including course planning and instruction in relevant subject areas. 

  • Collaborate closely with fellow PhD students, postdocs, and other members of the research group in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment. 

We are looking for detail-oriented, self-driven individuals with a passion for innovation and a commitment to excellence. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply. 

 

Required Qualifications 

  • A completed BSc and MSc degree in electronics, robotics, mechatronics, autonomous systems, or a closely related discipline. Applicants in the final semester of their master’s program are also encouraged to apply. 

  • Strong technical skills in areas such as digital electronics, hardware programming (FPGA/MPSoC), embedded hardware architectures, mechanical design, and wireless energy-harvesting technologies. 

  • Demonstrated ability in academic writing, including preparing scientific reports, documentation, and research publications. 

 

Please indicate in your application which PhD position you are applying for. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact the Head of Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid via email.

 

Please submit your application by August 10,2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Assessment and selection process 

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied. Only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Applicants will be informed of their assessment by the faculty. Interviews and tests may be part of the selection process.     

Application

 
Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant’s interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, skills, along with any other relevant information, e.g., teaching experience, computational skills, relevant projects, etc.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). Applicants in the final semester of their master’s program are requested to submit transcripts from all completed semesters. 

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included). 

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5-3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37,075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Start Your International Career as a Gourmet Butcher – Earn a Salary Throughout Your Apprenticeship - Greater Copenhagen, Denmark
description:
Are you a young EU citizen dreaming of a career in food craftsmanship?

This apprenticeship is open to EU citizens who have the right to live and work in Denmark.

At Born & Kolstrup in Rødovre, Denmark, you will receive a paid apprenticeship, an internationally recognised vocational qualification, and the opportunity to become part of one of Denmark's strongest butcher teams. We are proud winners of the Danish Butcher Award 2025 and are looking for a motivated apprentice who wants to develop in a profession built on quality, craftsmanship and teamwork – in a workplace with an informal management style, employee involvement and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Read more about the award:
https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/

What does a Gourmet Butcher do?

A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.

During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:

  • Cut and prepare premium meat products.

  • Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.

  • Develop new recipes and food products.

  • Work with food safety and quality control.

  • Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.

After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.

What can you expect from your apprenticeship?

We offer:

  • A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.

  • A thorough introduction and structured training programme.

  • Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.

  • A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.

  • Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.

  • An informal working environment with employee involvement.

  • Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.

  • A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.

Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.

  • Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.

  • Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.

  • Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.

  • Can communicate in English.

  • Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.

  • Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.

Salary and employment conditions

The apprenticeship lasts 3½ years, and you will receive a salary throughout the entire programme.

Monthly salary (collective agreement between DSM and the Danish Food Workers' Union, NNF):

Apprenticeship Year Salary (DKK) Approx. EUR

1st year per month 13.708 1.835

2nd year per month 17.343 2.321

Remaining apprenticeship per month 20.490 2.743

Adult apprentice per month 26.839 3.593

  • Working hours: 160.33 hours per month

  • Employer-paid pension contribution of 12.6% after three months of employment.

  • Salary is paid in Danish Kroner (DKK).

Your education

Your practical training will take place at Born & Kolstrup, located in Rødovre Centrum, just 8 km from Copenhagen City Hall Square.

The school-based training will take place at ZBC in Roskilde, Denmark's largest vocational college.

Ready to take the next step?

Would you like to build an international career with an award-winning company and become a skilled food craftsman in Denmark?

Born & Kolstrup

info@mmm-rc.dk

Learn more about us:

https://mmm-rc.dk/

Instagram:

@bornogkolstrup

title: DIAS Fellow in Engineering within Robotics
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Robotics. The candidate is expected to start on January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of Robotics, who is eager to develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should demonstrate: 

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

  • Have research experience in computer vision fields related to laboratory automation. This could include (but is not limited to) methods for:

    • vision-based handling of laboratory equipment, in particular glassware and fluids 

    • segmentation and vision-based handling of medical specimens and fluids

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of Robotics, such as robotics control, modelling, computer vision, medical/industrial robotics and artificial intelligence. 

  • Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries. 

  • Be fluent in English.

  • Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network, are considered comparative advantages.

  • Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally. 

 

The Department

MMMI

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The institute is the origin of robotics research in Denmark and has spawned the world-renowned cluster of robotics in Odense with more than 130 robotics companies including Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots. Building on our expertise in AI, robotics and software, we have raised strong research centres in related domains, such as Health Informatics and Energy Informatics, Drones and other relevant research areas. 

SDU Robotics

SDU Robotics conducts research among others within the fields of robotics and computer vision. The unit focuses on research problems from real robotics applications within manufacturing industries, hospitals, elderly care, and other partners in society. The unit also focuses on Robot related vision technologies for facilitating industrial part feeding, automated product assembly, uncertainty aware quality inspection, and biomedical segmentation for diagnosis and robot control. 

SDU Robotics’ research involves mathematical modeling and control of robots, robotic processes and robot systems, human-robot interactions, computer vision for reliable inspection and robot control, and simulation technologies for robotics and computer vision aimed at closing the Sim2Real gap. Artificial Intelligence is widely applied within all research fields. 

 

Additional information

For further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For more questions about the position please contact Head of Unit, Professor Thiusius Rajeeth Savarimuthu at trs@mmmi.sdu.dk.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The candidate will be attached to The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute in Odense and is also expected to participate in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense regularly.
The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Further information on salary and taxation.

 

The tenure track programme the Faculty of Engineering is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area. Candidates enter the assistant professor level (for up to 6 years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position of associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented independent scholarly output, ground-breaking publications, achievement of excellence grants, and international research network.
Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

To qualify for the position, you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline. 

 

Application requirements
The application must include the following:

  • Letter of motivation that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position.

  • Detailed CV including documentation of experience, and contacts for possible references. 

  • An elaborate research and funding plan (max 4 pages) for the next three years including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications, indicating which publications are most relevant for the position.

  • Up to five of the most relevant research articles – if you submit a monograph, it counts as 3 articles. Please upload a pdf for each publication. For co-authored publications, briefly describe the extent of the co-authorship or your contribution to the publications (please do this for each co-authored publication). You can do so by using this form or by describing the co-authorship in such a way that the committee can assess the extent of your contribution.

  • Teaching Portfolio as documentation for teaching and learning experience as well as supervision qualifications. Any format is acceptable, but you can find inspiration for structuring your teaching portfolio on the Faculty's teaching portfolio page.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you can find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark.

Submission guidelines

  • All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be protected by password. 

  • Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.

Assessment of applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicant will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. 

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation and references may be obtained. 

 

About SDU
SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.
SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.



Equal opportunity employment
The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.



How to apply
Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply online" link provided in the job posting.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.
 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

title: Spørg Egon ApS søger gulvsliber til fastansættelse
description:

Spørg Egon er en mindre virksomhed, der nu har muligheden for at vækste – derfor søger vi nu en ny medarbejder, der skal hjælpe os med at indfri vores visioner.

Har du lyst til at prøve kræfter i en lille virksomhed, der arbejder med gulvafslibning, hvor ingen dage er ens? Så læs med her.

Derudover udfører vi mindre reparationer af gulve. Vi er en virksomhed der vægter kvalitet og god service, og dette er vores varemærke, og det vi er kendt for. Du vil derfor blive en del af en virksomhed der sætter kunden først, og går langt for at de får den helt rigtige service og rådgivning.

Da vi som sagt har mulighed for at vækste, søger vi en ny medarbejder. Vi tilbyder bl.a.:

- Fastansættelse

- Løn efter kvalifikationer

- Godt arbejdsmiljø

- God oplæring og sparring

- Både selvstændigt arbejde, og arbejde i mindre team på 2 mand.

- 37 timers arbejdsuge – flere timer kan forekomme.

- Mulighed for firmabil, kun ved selvstændige opgaver.

- Varierede opgaver

Da vi har høje krav til os selv som arbejdsgiver og serviceudbyder, har vi også høje krav til vores kommende medarbejder.

Vores forventninger til dig:

- Servicemindet

- Ansvarsbevidst

- Kvalitetsbevidst

- Erfaring er et plus, men ikke afgørende da vi tilbyder grundig oplæring

- Kan arbejde selvstændigt, og i teams

- Mødestabil, vi skal kunne regne med dig

- Kørekort, kategori B

- Har du derudover erfaring inden for gulvlægning er dette et stort plus.

Hvis vi lyder som en virksomhed for dig, og har du mod på at prøve kræfter med et fysisk krævende arbejde, så tøv ikke med at kontakte os. Send os gerne din opdaterede ansøgning samt CV.

Vi ansætter en medarbejder snarest muligt, men venter på rette kandidat.

Derfor afholdes der også ansættelsessamtaler løbende.

Ved spørgsmål eller andet, send os da en mail på: info@sporgegon.dk

Vi modtager kun spørgsmål og ansøgninger/CV pr. mail. Skriv gerne ”Til stillingen gulvsliber” i emnefelt.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Danilo Prelevic

Spørg Egon ApS

In english:

Spørg Egon ApS is looking for a floor sander for permanent employment. Spørg Egon is a smaller business, which now has the opportunity to grow – therefore we are now looking for a new empluyee, that will help us realize our visions.

Do you want to try to work in a smaller business, that works with floor sanding, and where no two days are the same? Then read along. Spørg Egon ApS covers whole Sjælland, and does all types of floor sanding and treatments of floors/stairs/tabletops/kitchen countertops etc. In addition we also carry out minor repairs to floors.

We are a company that values good quality and good service, this is our trademark, and what we are known for. You will therefore become part of a company that puts the customer first, and goes to great lengths to ensure that they get the right service and advise throughout our cooperation.

As we have the opportunity to grow, we are looking for a new employee. We offer, among other things:

- Permanent employment

- Salary according to qualifications

- Good work environment

- Good training and sparring

- Both independant work, and work in a small team of two people.

- 37 hour working week – more hours can occur.

- Possibility of a company car – only for independent tasks.

- Varied taskes

As we have high demands to our self as employer and service provider, we also have high demands to our future employee.

Our expectations to you:

- Serviceminded

- Responsible

- Quality conscious

- Experience is a plus, but not essential as we offer thorough training.

- Can work independently and in teams

- Meeting stability – we must be able to count on you.

- Driving license cat. B

- If you also have experience in flooring, this is a big plus.

If we aound like a company for you, and you have the courage to try your hand at a physically demanding job, do not hesitate to contact us. Please send us your updated application and CV.

We are looking to hire an employee as soon as possible, but we are waiting for the right candidate. Therefore, employment interviews are also held on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions, send us an email at: info@sporgegon.dk

We only receive questions and applications/CV per email. Please write “For the position floor sander” in the subject field.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Danilo Prelevic

Spørg Egon ApS

title: Electronics Production Technician
description:
Work tasks: The role
As an Electronics Production Technician, you will support the assembly, inspection, testing and rework of electronic components and printed circuit boards used in our products and development systems. You will work closely with our engineering team, following technical documentation and testing procedures, identifying faults and recording results accurately. Your work will help ensure that our electronic assemblies meet the required quality and performance standards. This role is suitable for someone with a vocational background or practical experience in electronics who enjoys precise, hands-on work and wants to develop their skills in an advanced engineering environment. Key responsibilities • Assemble electronic components, printed circuit boards and related systems • Inspect incoming PCB assemblies, components and solder joints visually and under a microscope • Perform soldering, cleaning, handling and rework of PCB assemblies • Carry out electrical measurements and functional testing using standard test equipment and dedicated test rigs • Identify faults, perform initial troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to engineers • Read and follow electronic schematics, datasheets, assembly instructions and testing procedures • Prepare cables, connectors and electronic connections • Record inspection, testing and rework results accurately • Maintain the traceability of components and completed work • Monitor electronic component and consumable inventory and communicate replenishment needs • Provide practical feedback and suggest improvements to assembly, testing and work procedures

We offer: What we offer
• A monthly gross salary of €2394–€3724 depending on your experience and skills • Hands-on work with advanced space and optical communication technology • Close cooperation with electronics, embedded software and mechanical engineers • The opportunity to help establish and improve assembly and testing processes as the company grows • Varied work across electronics assembly, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and production support • A small international team where your contribution has a visible impact on the final product Occasional remote work for suitable tasks may be agreed with the hiring manager. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager.

Other requirements: What we are looking for
Required experience • Vocational education in electronics or equivalent practical experience • Practical experience with electronics assembly and PCB handling • Ability to read electronic schematics, component datasheets and technical instructions • Soldering and PCB rework skills • Ability to use standard electronic test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes and laboratory power supplies • Ability to identify electronic components and understand their markings and package information • Basic fault-finding and troubleshooting skills • A careful, methodical and quality-focused approach • Ability to follow procedures and document work accurately • English at B2 level or above • Willingness to learn new equipment, processes and techniques We welcome applications from both experienced technicians and strong junior candidates with relevant practical skills and a solid foundation in electronics. Nice to have • Experience with surface-mount and through-hole soldering • Experience using hot-air rework equipment • Experience with FBGA rework or reballing • Experience operating pick-and-place or reflow equipment • Experience testing PCB assemblies using dedicated test rigs • Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards or relevant IPC certification • Experience maintaining production, testing or traceability records • Experience with component inventory and production consumables • Previous experience in electronics production, prototyping or a laboratory environment

Option to work from home: No

description:

Working arrangement: This is a primarily onsite position in Tallinn, Estonia, as the role involves close collaboration with hardware, integration and testing. Limited hybrid work may be agreed depending on the employee’s responsibilities and the stage of the work. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager. Other important information: This position may require the selected candidate to be eligible to obtain government security clearance. At Golbriak Space, we use our passion for purposeful innovation to help keep people safe and solve complex engineering challenges. We foster an inclusive environment built on integrity, responsibility and employee empowerment.

title: Instruktor/ Veespordijuhendaja (eFoil – elektriline lendav laud) suvehooajaks
description:
Oleme valmis värbama ka alaealisi. Hooajaline töö mere ääres — õpetad inimesi sõitma elektrilise surfiga, nautima elu ja tundma vabadust

Tööülesanded: Mida sa tegelikult teed?
Sa ei istu kontoris. Sa ei vasta e-kirjadele 8 tundi järjest. Hommikul tuled mere äärde. Päike tõuseb Tallinna lahel. Võtad vastu esimesed külalised — mõned erutunud, mõned natuke hirmul. Annad neile 15-20 minutit ohutusinstruktaaži. Selgitad. Naeratad. Tekitad usalduse. Lähed nendega vette või paadiga kõrval. Näed hetke, kui inimene esimest korda lendab üle vee. Nende nägu ütleb kõik. Filmid neid paadilt, kaldalt — sisu, mis läheb viraalseks. Hoolitsed varustuse eest nagu oma asja eest. Laed akud, puhastd tahvlid, hoiad kogu ala korras ja puhtana. Järgmine klient peab nägema täiuslikku — mitte seda, mis järele jäi. Õhtul — loojang mere kohal. Saun. Ice bath.Jacuzzi. Klientide tänulikud sõnad.

Omalt poolt pakume: Mida sa saad vastu?
→ Tasuta eFoil-sõit! Klientidele see maksab 200€ tunnis. Sinu jaoks — tasuta. → Töö maailma ühe coolima spordiga päikesetõusu ja -loojangu ajal → Tulemustasu + boonused → Sinu nägu on meie sotsiaalmeedia — ehitame koos brändi → Võimalus meiega kasvada — Euroopa, maailm on järgmised → Oled osa millestki, mida pole varem olnud — uue turu ehitamine

Muud nõuded: Keda me otsime?
→ Sa oled füüsiliselt aktiivne — see töö nõuab ikka jõudu, vastupidavust ja liikumist → Sa oskad hästi ujuda ja tunneksid end vabalt avatud vees → Suhtled inimestega loomulikult — see on su tugevus, mitte kohustus → Räägid eesti keelt + inglise ja boonuseks - vene keelt → Oled vastutustundlik ja rahulik ka siis, kui kõik ei lähe plaanipäraselt Me otsime inimest, kes näeb mis on vaja — ja teeb ära. Kes kliendi naeratuse nimel läheb sammu kaugemale ilma, et keegi paluks. Kes vee peal teeb kiireid otsuseid ise — rahulikult, kindlalt. Kes võtab vastutuse enda peale — mitte ei otsi, kelle peale näidata. Positiivsus ei ole siin soov. See on nõue. Energiat, initsiatiivi ja täielikku pühendumist — iga päev, mitte ainult headel päevadel. Suur boonus (aga mitte kohustuslik): → Kogemus surfimises, kite, wake, SUP või muus veespordis → Oled filminud videoid või tead, kuidas Instagram/TikTok toimib → Oled varem töötanud instruktori, giidi või teenindajana Pole kunagi eFoil'i sõitnud? Pole probleemi. Õpetame sind.

title: International Coach Driver (FlixBus)
description:
The role is operated in cooperation with FlixBus, and all routes originate from Tallinn.

Work tasks: About the Company
RTX Lines OÜ is a reliable transportation partner providing charter services, employee transportation, and international passenger transport services in Estonia and on international routes. We believe that every successful journey begins with well-organized transportation. Thanks to our modern fleet and high standards of safety and customer service, we ensure a comfortable and dependable travel experience. Since 2015, FlixBus has expanded rapidly and now operates in more than 40 countries across Europe, North America, and South America, offering one of Europe's largest long-distance coach networks. Job Description RTX Lines OÜ is looking for an International Bus Driver & Customer Service Representative to join our team. The role is operated in cooperation with FlixBus, and all routes start from Tallinn. If you value a professional working environment, modern equipment, and the opportunity to provide high-quality service to passengers on international European coach routes, we would like to hear from you. Main Responsibilities * Operating international passenger transport services within the FlixBus network. * Ensuring safe, punctual, and pleasant service for passengers throughout the journey. * Conducting pre-departure vehicle inspections and following employer instructions and procedures. * Checking tickets and passenger information and assisting passengers when necessary. * Complying with driving and rest time regulations and using the tachograph correctly. * Representing the company in a professional and customer-friendly manner. Candidate Requirements: * Valid Category D driving licence. * Valid medical certificate. * Valid professional bus driver qualification certificate (Code 95) and driver card. * Customer-oriented mindset and a safe, economical driving style. * Responsible attitude, accuracy, and reliability in daily work. * Previous experience in international passenger transport. * Communication-level proficiency in Estonian and English. Knowledge of Russian, German, or Latvian is considered an advantage. * Interest in buses and customer service, and motivation to work as an international bus driver. * Ability to use a smartphone, as daily work tasks and communication are managed through mobile applications. * Valid residence permit and the legal right to work in the European Union.

We offer: * Net monthly income starting from €2,100 (depending on the schedule and hours worked).
* Stable employment in international passenger transport services. * Work starting from Tallinn. * Accommodation provided by the employer while on routes. * If needed, accommodation in Tallinn before the start of a route (for candidates relocating or travelling from further away). * A modern and well-maintained fleet of coaches. * Practical and professional workwear. * Job-related training opportunities. * A fixed work schedule or a schedule agreed upon individually. * A friendly and supportive team. Benefits and Perks: * Stebby sports and wellness allowance. * Birthday recognition from the company. * Summer and winter team events. * Discounted travel opportunities on FlixBus services for the driver and their family members.

Other requirements: Candidate requirements:
* Category D driving licence and a valid professional bus driver qualification certificate (Code 095) * Previous work experience in international passenger transport * Willingness to work on a shift schedule, including night shifts and weekends * Interest in buses and customer service, and motivation to work as a bus driver in international transport operations. * Valid residence permit and the legal right to work in the European Union

Option to work from home: No

work includes night shifts

title: Electronics Production Technician
description:
Work tasks: The role
As an Electronics Production Technician, you will support the assembly, inspection, testing and rework of electronic components and printed circuit boards used in our products and development systems. You will work closely with our engineering team, following technical documentation and testing procedures, identifying faults and recording results accurately. Your work will help ensure that our electronic assemblies meet the required quality and performance standards. This role is suitable for someone with a vocational background or practical experience in electronics who enjoys precise, hands-on work and wants to develop their skills in an advanced engineering environment. Key responsibilities • Assemble electronic components, printed circuit boards and related systems • Inspect incoming PCB assemblies, components and solder joints visually and under a microscope • Perform soldering, cleaning, handling and rework of PCB assemblies • Carry out electrical measurements and functional testing using standard test equipment and dedicated test rigs • Identify faults, perform initial troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to engineers • Read and follow electronic schematics, datasheets, assembly instructions and testing procedures • Prepare cables, connectors and electronic connections • Record inspection, testing and rework results accurately • Maintain the traceability of components and completed work • Monitor electronic component and consumable inventory and communicate replenishment needs • Provide practical feedback and suggest improvements to assembly, testing and work procedures

We offer: What we offer
• A monthly gross salary of €2394–€3724 depending on your experience and skills • Hands-on work with advanced space and optical communication technology • Close cooperation with electronics, embedded software and mechanical engineers • The opportunity to help establish and improve assembly and testing processes as the company grows • Varied work across electronics assembly, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and production support • A small international team where your contribution has a visible impact on the final product Occasional remote work for suitable tasks may be agreed with the hiring manager. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager.

Other requirements: What we are looking for
Required experience • Vocational education in electronics or equivalent practical experience • Practical experience with electronics assembly and PCB handling • Ability to read electronic schematics, component datasheets and technical instructions • Soldering and PCB rework skills • Ability to use standard electronic test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes and laboratory power supplies • Ability to identify electronic components and understand their markings and package information • Basic fault-finding and troubleshooting skills • A careful, methodical and quality-focused approach • Ability to follow procedures and document work accurately • English at B2 level or above • Willingness to learn new equipment, processes and techniques We welcome applications from both experienced technicians and strong junior candidates with relevant practical skills and a solid foundation in electronics. Nice to have • Experience with surface-mount and through-hole soldering • Experience using hot-air rework equipment • Experience with FBGA rework or reballing • Experience operating pick-and-place or reflow equipment • Experience testing PCB assemblies using dedicated test rigs • Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards or relevant IPC certification • Experience maintaining production, testing or traceability records • Experience with component inventory and production consumables • Previous experience in electronics production, prototyping or a laboratory environment

Option to work from home: No

title: Servant of the restaurant
description:
Seasonal work during the summer period

Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

title: Doctoral Researcher, Strategic Business Development (H2Nexus Project)
description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking a motivated and talented Doctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded H2NEXUS project.

The position is full-time and fixed-term (3 years), aligned with the duration of the H2NEXUS project. The preferred start date is September 2026 or as agreed. The position is located in the [School of Management](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/university/organisation-and-management/school-management) in the [Strategic Business Development](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/groups-and-focus-areas/strategic-business-development)research grouphttps://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/groups/public-policy-and-governance. The position is located in Vaasa.

About the Project

The H2Nexus project investigates the co-evolution of markets and energy ecosystems, with a particular focus on the emergence of the hydrogen economy in Finland. The project enables a comprehensive understanding of the systemic change through a dual approach: combining techno-economic modelling with a theoretical lens that views markets as designed and evolving coordination systems.

The project explores how institutional work and market practices shape the development and stabilization of key components such as business model innovation, pricing mechanisms, and ecosystem governance. A central research objective is to analyze the conditions and mechanisms that enable or hinder the transition from early-stage development to more mature and institutionalized stages.

Quantitative and qualitative analyses will be integrated into this research, particularly to analyze the impacts of new hydrogen markets and regulations on both the overall energy system and business cases in some hard-to-abate sectors, such as the production of steel, fertilizers, shipping fuels, and aviation fuels. The research will incorporate project-level and system-level models for hydrogen and its derivatives, aligned with market-shaping theory.

The project will produce new knowledge on the clean hydrogen market from market-ecosystem, business case, and energy system perspectives, as well as relevant new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilized in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

Your Role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasizes the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key Responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research on ecosystem emergence, market shaping, and business model innovation.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, manufacturers, retailers, and civil society organisations.
- Participate in data collection (e.g., interviews, workshops, case studies), analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

A person who has completed a suitable higher university degree (see below) and is a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa can be selected for the position of Doctoral Researcher. We therefore expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree. The selected candidate needs to apply for doctoral studies through a separate application to the University of Vaasa's Graduate School | [Read more about doctoral education, application and eligibility for studies.](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- Masters degree in a relevant field of business studies, such as management, industrial management, B2B management, or a related field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent communication skills in English.
- Motivation to produce high-quality research outputs.

Desirable:

- Experience with qualitative or mixed methods research.
- Experience working with industry stakeholders.
- Experience related to the project's context, whether it be energy or even hydrogen.

Read more about the selection process and language policies: [University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/open-positions/application-and-selection-process)

We offer

- A fully funded doctoral researcher position (3 years) aligned with a high-profile Research Council of Finland project.
- The selected applicant will be accepted into the University of Vaasas Doctoral Programme and will pursue their doctoral degree in Management after a separate application process.
- Opportunity to collaborate with leading experts across Europe.
- Training in doctoral research, methods, and professional skills.
- Access to industry cases, real-world data, and hands-on circular innovation activities.
- Supportive research environment within the University of Vaasas vibrant research community.

We promote the overall well-being of our employees at work by, among other things, offering fitness and cultural benefits, extensive occupational health care services, and versatile opportunities for continuous learning. F

_Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment which is free from any form of discrimination._

**Would you be our new Project Specialist?**

We are looking for a Project Specialist to join Konecranes and play a key role in customer invoicing and project support activities related to crane delivery projects. In this role, you will be responsible for both external and internal customer invoicing in Finland while also supporting invoicing-related activities across the Nordic countries. You will work closely with project managers and sales teams, ensuring that invoicing, project administration and project closing activities are completed accurately and efficiently.

Your day-to-day work will focus primarily on invoicing-related tasks, including handling bank and corporate guarantees as well as credit note processes. You will support project and order closing activities in SAP and help ensure that invoicing and project processes run smoothly throughout the entire project lifecycle. In addition, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of processes and ways of working, and when needed, support project managers with various administrative tasks.

The position is a full-time fixed-term assignment for 12 months, with a possibility for continuation. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Konecranes. We hope you can start as soon as possible, preferably during September 2026. The role is based in Hämeenlinna and offers a hybrid working model after the onboarding period.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a professional with an interest in invoicing, project support and business processes. To succeed in this role, we hope you have previous experience in invoicing-related tasks and ideally a commercial, business, or finance-related educational background. Experience with SAP is considered a strong advantage, particularly if you have worked with invoicing or order-related processes. You communicate fluently in Finnish and have a good command of English, as you will collaborate with stakeholders in Finland and across the Nordic countries.

As a person, you are proactive, systematic and solution-oriented. You enjoy taking ownership of your work and can work independently while also collaborating effectively with stakeholders. Strong communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to solve problems are important in this role, as you will need to identify and resolve invoicing-related issues and help ensure that processes run smoothly. We also value a development-oriented mindset and an interest in improving ways of working and creating more efficient processes.

**Why join Konecranes?**

Konecranes offers you an opportunity to work in a global technology company whose solutions help keep ports and industries moving around the world. You will join an experienced and supportive team where expertise is actively shared and learning is encouraged. Through this role, you will gain broad exposure to delivery projects, project business, and SAP-based processes, giving you a comprehensive understanding of how customer projects progress from order creation all the way to final delivery and invoicing.

As your expertise grows, you will have opportunities to expand your responsibilities and explore different career paths within Konecranes. The experience gained in this role can provide a strong foundation for future opportunities in project management, project support, and specialist positions. In addition, this role supports a long-term business need, meaning there is a possibility to continue your career with Konecranes after the initial assignment period.

**Are you interested?**

If you are interested, we would love to hear from you as soon as possible. Please submit your application via the link by 20.8.2026. Interviews will be started already during the application period, and the position will be filled once the right person is found.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information on the position, please contact Elise Niinimäki, HR Coordinator, email: **elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi**.

title: Safariopas ja kuljettaja Kilpisjärvelle – vietä talvi Suomen upeimmissa tunturimaisemissa
description:
Haluatko viettää talven paikassa, jossa työpäivä voi alkaa moottorikelkkasafarilla, jatkua kuljetuksella Norjan vuonoille ja päättyä revontulien loisteeseen?

Kilpissafarit etsii tiimiinsä aktiivista ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä safariopasta ja kuljettajaa talvikaudelle Kilpisjärvelle.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työn kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa, upeissa tunturimaisemissa ja osana pientä, ammattitaitoista työyhteisöä.

Mitä työ sisältää?

Työ on ennen kaikkea asiakaspalvelua ja opastamista. Vastaat siitä, että asiakkaamme saavat turvallisen, sujuvan ja mieleenpainuvan elämyksen.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen ja opastaminen

- moottorikelkka-, lumikenkä- ja muiden aktiviteettien ohjaaminen

- asiakkaiden kuljettaminen yrityksen bussilla tarvittaessa

- varusteiden valmistelu ja huolto

- kalustosta huolehtiminen

- muut matkailuyrityksen päivittäiset tehtävät


Kuljetuksia on vain osa työstä – pääpaino on asiakkaiden opastamisessa ja laadukkaan elämyksen tuottamisessa.

Toivomme sinulta

- D-ajokorttia ja voimassa olevaa kuljettajan ammattipätevyyttä

- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- iloista ja asiakaslähtöistä työotetta

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja vastuullisuutta

- kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä


Eduksi katsomme

- aiemman kokemuksen matkailu- tai ohjelmapalvelualalta

- ensiapukoulutuksen

- muun kielitaidon

- kokemuksen moottorikelkoista tai muista ulkoaktiviteeteista


Vaikka et täyttäisi jokaista kohtaa, kannustamme silti hakemaan, jos uskot olevasi oikea henkilö tehtävään.

Mitä tarjoamme?

- Palkka 19 €/h

- Monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työn

- Kattavan perehdytyksen

- Hyvät työvälineet ja laadukkaan kaluston

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi matkailualalla

- Pienen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

- Edullisen, kalustetun majoituksen Kilpisjärvellä


Miksi Kilpisjärvi?

Kilpisjärvi on yksi Suomen ainutlaatuisimmista matkailukohteista. Työpäivien aikana pääset liikkumaan tuntureilla, työskentelemään kansainvälisten asiakkaiden kanssa ja kokemaan arktisen luonnon parhaimmillaan.

Vapaa-ajalla käytössäsi ovat:

- upeat vaellusreitit

- laskettelu ja maastohiihto

- kalastus

- Norjan vuonot vain noin 50 kilometrin päässä

- revontulet ja tunturiluonto aivan kotiovella


Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos viihdyt ihmisten parissa, pidät vaihtelevista työpäivistä ja haluat viettää talven paikassa, josta moni tulee vain haaveilemaan.

Työsuhde

- Talvikausi 2026–2027

- Työsuhde tai halutessasi myös yrittäjäsopimus

- Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan


Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä sopisit osaksi Kilpissafareiden tiimiä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Arctic Experience Guide (Entrepreneur/toiminimi)
description:
Arctic Experience Guide (Entrepreneur/toiminimi)

title: Klinikbiträde
description:
Vi på MarieVet söker klinikbiträde/djurvårdare till vår klinik i Mariehamn med ca 80% anställning, motsvarande ca 30h/vecka.

Vår verksamhet består idag av två veterinärer, tre djursjukvårdare och två klinikbiträden. Vi har en välutrustad klinik med labb, röntgen, ultraljud, operationsavdelning samt tandsal med tandröntgen. Våra patienter är främst hundar och katter, men vi tar även emot gnagare och exotics. Vi brinner för att erbjuda modern, evidensbaserad vård samt att ha personlig kontakt med våra kunder.

Som klinikbiträde hos oss är dina främsta uppgifter att bemanna receptionen, städa efter patienter, instrumentvård, hjälpande hand med patienterna som t.ex. blodprovstagning och kloklippning.

Vi söker dig som är utbildad djurvårdare, har erfarenhet av att arbeta som klinikbiträde på smådjursklinik eller har annan motsvarande arbetserfarenhet. Du ska tycka om att jobba i team och vara bekväm med kundkontakt då receptionen är vårt ansikte utåt. Som person önskar vi att du är stresstålig, noggrann och organiserad. Vi ser gärna att du är ambitiös och tycker om att utvecklas i din roll.

Arbetstiden är förlagd mellan våra öppettider som är 08-18 måndagar-torsdagar. Övriga tider kan förekomma enligt överenskommelse.

Lön enligt Erto:s rekommendationer för veterinärkliniker.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tillträde kan ske innan utsatt datum.

title: Produktförvaltare Data till Produktförvaltning
description:
Vill du vara med och stärka hur Ålandsbanken arbetar med datakvalitet, datastyrning och uppföljning inom finansieringsområdet? Vi söker nu en Produktförvaltare Data som vill bidra till att utveckla våra arbetssätt och skapa långsiktig nytta för både verksamheten och våra kunder. I rollen får du en central position i utvecklingen av hur data används, kvalitetssäkras och följs upp inom banken. Du bidrar till att vår data är korrekt, spårbar och ändamålsenlig – både för affärsstyrning, rapportering och regulatoriska krav.

Din roll

Som Produktförvaltare Data ingår du i Produktförvaltningens processeffektiviseringsteam. Här får du en viktig roll i att utveckla arbetssätt, kontroller och uppföljning som stärker bankens användning av data. I nära samarbete med verksamheten, Data Governance och IT bidrar du till att omsätta behov och krav till praktiska lösningar som skapar värde i det dagliga arbetet.

I rollen arbetar du bland annat med att:

- Utveckla, definiera och följa upp kontroller för datakvalitet, dataflöden och affärsregler.

- Identifiera och driva förbättringar som gör data mer tillförlitlig, spårbar och användbar.

- Samverka med olika delar av organisationen, framför allt verksamheten, Data Governance och IT.

- Medverka i kravställning, testning, prioritering och uppföljning kopplat till regelverk, rapportering och verksamhetens behov.


Din bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av arbete med data, analys, informationshantering eller uppföljning och som har god förståelse för processer, interna kontroller och hur krav kan omsättas till fungerande arbetssätt.

Du har högskoleutbildning med system- eller ekonomisk inriktning, alternativt motsvarande relevant arbetserfarenhet. Eftersom vårt arbetsspråk är svenska behöver du behärska svenska väl i både tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från bank, finans eller annan reglerad verksamhet, särskilt inom finansieringsområdet. Tidigare kunskap inom finansieringsområdet och goda kunskaper i engelska ser vi också som värdefullt.

Din profil

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är strukturerad, analytisk och initiativrik. Du har förmåga att driva frågor framåt, skapa struktur i en roll under utveckling och kommunicera tydligt och pedagogiskt med både verksamhet och tekniska intressenter. Du samarbetar gärna tvärfunktionellt, anpassar dig till ändrade förutsättningar och motiveras av att förstå samband, förbättra flöden och skapa lösningar som gör verklig nytta för både verksamheten och bankens kunder.

Om du vill kombinera verksamhetsförståelse, data, analys och förändringsarbete i en roll med hög påverkan, ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

Att bli en del av oss

Som del av vårt team får du vara med där det händer. Vi erbjuder dig en engagerad arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med ett ambitiöst och lösningsfokuserat team. Arbetet är intressant med mångsidiga arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter att utvecklas inom finansieringsområdet.

Här kan du läsa mer om vad vi erbjuder dig som blir en del av laget Ålandsbanken!

https://www.alandsbanken.ax/om-oss/karriar/arbeta-pa-alandsbanken (Mariehamn)

https://www.alandsbanken.fi/sv/om-oss/karriar/arbeta-pa-alandsbanken (Helsingfors)

Vill du veta mer?

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering i Mariehamn eller Helsingfors.

Närmare upplysningar kring tjänsten ges av Avdelningschef Johanna Beeks, Johanna.Beeks@alandsbanken.fi.

Sista ansökningsdag för tjänsten är den 16.08.2026. Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden.

Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Uppsökande ungdomsarbete
employer: Sveps / Svenska Framtidsskolan i Helsingforsregionen Ab
description:
Sveps ungdomsverkstaden lediganslår ett vikariat inom uppsökande ungdomsarbete 25.9.2026-17.9.2027.

Som anställd inom det uppsökande ungdomsarbetet är dina arbetsuppgifter att handleda och stöda unga som saknar arbete eller studieplats. Du arbetar utgående från den ungas behov och förutsättningar, stöder de unga i bl.a. vardags- och livshanteringsfrågor, hjälpa dessa finna de tjänster som de är i behov av samt förbereder den unga att ta emot rätt sorts stöd. Arbetet är självständigt i dialog med den unga, med ett nära samarbete med uppsökande teamet samt med Sveps övriga personal.

Som uppsökare förutsätts du ha god kännedom om samhällets välfärdstjänster, erfarenhet av nätverksarbete och god samarbetsförmåga. Du förväntas ha en god kompetens i bemötande av personer i olika livssituationer och med olika bakgrund. Du bör ha utmärkta kunskaper i svenska (muntligt och skriftligt) samt förmåga att arbeta på finska.

Vi önskar att du har högskoleexamen och mångårig arbetserfarenhet inom det pedagogiska, sociala området eller annan lämplig bransch. Vi uppskattar speciellt erfarenhet av arbete med unga.

För att kunna genomföra ett gott arbete skall du ha god initiativförmåga och arbeta lösningsorienterat.

Vi erbjuder dig ett omväxlande och intressant arbete i en trevlig arbetsgemenskap i centrala Helsingfors.

title: Autoasentaja
description:
**Etsimme tiimiimme ammattitaitoista, oma-aloitteista ja reipasta autonasentajaa kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen!** Alkuun etsimme **kahta asentajaa**, ja myöhemmin hakusessa on vielä yksi henkilö lisää.

Meillä pääset osaksi hyvää nuorekasta työporukkaa ja saat käyttöösi laadukkaat työkalut, nostimet, diagnostiikkalaitteet ym. Etsimme tekijää, jolla on asenne kohdallaan, hyvät tiimityötaidot ja halu tarttua monipuolisesti kaikkiin korjaamon töihin.

**Työtehtävät:**

- kaikki autoasentajan työt (mukaan lukien mm. määräaikaishuollot, jakopää- ja kytkinremontit, moottorinvaihdot, rengastyöt, alusta- ja jarruremontit, automaattivaihteiston öljynvaihdot sekä diagnostiikan jne). Toinen paikka voidaan täyttää myös perushuoltoihin ja alustatoimiin keskittyvällä tekijällä.


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Kokemusta alan töistä ja B-ajokorttia.

- Reipasta otetta työhön ja kykyä työskennellä osana porukkaa.


**Isoa plussaa antavat:**

- Osaaminen ja kokemus sähkövianhausta.

- Osaaminen moottoripyörien korjaamisesta.


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Säännöllisen työajan: **ma–pe klo 9.00–17.00**.

- Hyvät työkalut ja nykyaikaiset toimitilat.

- **Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen:** Vähintään Autoalan TES:n mukainen, mutta kokemus ja osaaminen huomioidaan palkassa.

description:
**Haetaan kerho-ohjaajia**

Welhot etsii ohjaajia salibandykerhoihin (5-12 vuotiaat pojat ja tytöt) syys/talvikaudelle 2026-2027. Kerhotoiminta alkaa syyskuussa 2026 (vko 37) ja kausi jatkuu toukokuuhun 2027 (vko 19) asti

- Oman liikuntaharrastustaustan (etenkin salibandy)

10€-13€ / harjoituskerta aiemmasta ohjaajakokemuksesta riippuen + 30€ / Junnuliigan-turnaus. Palkkiot maksetaan toteutuneiden ohjauskertojen mukaan.

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja
description:
**Etsitkö työtä, jossa näkyy kädenjälkesi? Haemme sinua**

**Kunnossapitoasentaja**

**Lappeenrannan leipomolle vakituiseen työsuhteeseen**

Kunnossapitoasentajana työskentelet Lappeenrannan leipomon tuotantolaitteiden parissa monipuolisissa mekaanisissa asennus- ja kunnossapitotehtävissä. Olet osa tehtaan omaa seitsemän henkilön kunnossapitotiimiä. Tehtävät pitävät sisällään teollisen leipomon tuotantolinjojen teknistä ylläpitoa ja vianselvitystä, ennakkohuoltoja sekä muutos- ja perusparannustöitä. Työssä on vastuuta ja vapautta sopivassa suhteessa.

Työtä tehdään kolmessa vuorossa: aamuvuorossa klo 06–14, iltavuorossa klo 14–22 sekä yövuorossa klo 22–06. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen (40 h/vko).

**Miksi Fazer Leipomot?**

Meillä kaikki alkaa ihmisistä. Olet osa kannustavaa ja lämminhenkistä työyhteisöä, jossa työkaverit jakavat osaamistaan ja oppivat toisiltaan. Vuosittain tekemämme henkilöstökyselyn mukaan kunnossapito-osasto koetaan reiluksi työyhteisöksi, jossa viihdytään hyvin. Kunnossapitoasentajana sinulle tarjoutuu mahdollisuus kasvattaa omaa osaamistasi mukavassa ja kannustavassa tiimissä. Työ on itsenäistä ja vaihtelevaa, eikä yksikään päivä ole samanlainen.

Me Fazerilla haluamme luoda monimuotoisuuden ja osallisuuden kulttuurin sekä tarjota tasavertaisen työyhteisön, jossa kaikkia työntekijöitä kunnioitetaan ja jossa työympäristö koetaan motivoivaksi ja turvalliseksi.

**Palkkaus**

Tehtävä kuuluu leipomoiden työntekijöitä koskeva työehtosopimuksen piiriin. Aloituspalkka tehtävässä on 2150 € – 3050 € / kk riippuen valitun henkilön koulutuksesta ja aiemmasta alan työkokemuksesta. Peruspalkan lisäksi maksamme erilaisia lisiä, esimerkiksi iltavuorolisää 1,91 € – 2,46 € / h ja yövuorolisää 13,99 € – 20,58 € / h.

Tehtävässä on mahdollisuus liiketoimintakohtaiseen tuotannon tulospalkkioon, jonka tavoitetaso on 74senttiä / h (rakenne ja ehdot määritellään vuosittain).

Tarjoamme lisäksi monipuolisia etuja, kuten esimerkiksialennuksia Fazerin tuotteista sekä etuja hyvinvointiin, kuten Epassin.

**Mitä toivomme sinun tuovan tiimiin?**

Sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta kunnossapidon työtehtävistä sekä tekniikan alan koulutus. Eduksi tehtävässä katsomme leipomokoneiden tuntemuksen, sähkö-/automaatio-osaamisen sekä mekaanisen kunnossapidon osaamisen. Lisäksi edellytämme valmiutta työskennellä vuorotyössä.

Kokemusta tärkeämpää meille on kuitenkin aktiivinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote sekä motivaatio uuden oppimiseen. Sinut tunnetaan mukavana työkaverina, ja nautit onnistumisista. Positiivinen asenteesi säilyy myös tiukoissa tilanteissa. Toimit johdonmukaisesti työturvallisuus edellä niin arjessa kuin kiire- ja painetilanteissakin.

**Hae nyt ja tule mukaan tiimiin, joka luo merkityksellisiä hetkiä**

Haku on auki 16.8. saakka. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa leipomon tekninen päällikkö Antti Juha numerosta 040 8443 522 arkisin klo 12–14.

_Ruokaelämyksiin keskittyvänä yrityksenä Fazer mahdollistaa jokaiselle päivän parhaista hetkistä nauttimisen. Missiomme, Ruokaa, jolla on merkitys, rakentuu vankalle, yli130-vuotiaalle perinnöllemme, kuluttajalähtöisyydelle ja innovaatioille kehittäessämme tulevaisuuden ruokaelämyksiä. Lähes 6 000 omistautuneen ammattilaisen voimin keskitymme kuluttajatuotteisiin ja suoraan kuluttajaliiketoimintaamme Pohjois-Euroopassa, minkä lisäksi tuotteitamme viedään yli 40 maahan. Fazer noudattaa liiketoiminnassaan eettisiä ohjeita, jotka pohjautuvat konsernin arvoihin ja YK:n Global Compact -aloitteen periaatteisiin. Fazer-konsernin liikevaihto vuonna 2025 oli 1,2 miljardia euroa._

title: Mechanical Design Team Leader
description:
**The opportunity**

At Hitachi Energy, we are looking for a Mechanical Design Team Leader to join our Transformers Business in Vaasa, Finland. In this role, you will support and coordinate a small team of skilled design engineers while contributing your own expertise to challenging customer projects. This is not a traditional people management role but an opportunity to coordinate and support a small team of engineers, foster collaboration, and drive successful project delivery.

In this role, you will lead a team of mechanical design engineers working with some of the industry's most advanced transformer and reactor solutions. You will combine hands-on engineering expertise with people leadership, guiding your team through demanding customer projects while ensuring high-quality, innovative, and sustainable designs.

As part of our global engineering organization, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across functions and regions, playing a key role in delivering world-class transformer solutions that support the ongoing energy transition.

**How you'll make an impact**

\- Lead, support, and coordinate a team of mechanical design engineers

\- Ensure efficient project execution and follow project progress across the team

\- Drive collaboration between engineering, procurement, production, and quality functions

\- Foster a positive, engaging, and high-performing team environment

\- Build strong relationships with external partners and subcontractors

\- Contribute to technical problem-solving and decision-making in customer projects

\- Support continuous improvement initiatives and the development of team competencies

\- Promote safe, sustainable, and high-quality engineering practices

**Your background**

\- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in electrical or mechanical engineering

\- Previous experience in mechanical engineering, preferably within industrial product design or manufacturing

\- Experience in team leadership, coaching, or coordinating engineering activities is considered an advantage

\- Knowledge of 3D CAD tools and mechanical design processes

\- Experience with project planning tools such as MS Project or MS Planner is beneficial

\- Understanding of manufacturing processes and engineering documentation is considered a plus

\- Strong communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken

title: Köksmästare till Park Alandia Hotell
description:
Park Alandia Hotell är ett familjeägt hotell med fokus på laganda, arbetsglädje och service. I hotellet finns vår stilfulla nyrenoverade restaurang med bar och uteservering, konferens- och festvåning samt en härlig bastu- och poolavdelning. Skön livemusik spelas fredag-lördag året om och vår uteservering med ca 90 sittplatser har många soltimmar. Vi är cirka 25 medarbetare året runt och nästan 50 under sommarsäsongen.

Nu satsar vi vidare genom att bygga ett eget mikrobryggeri där vi ska brygga vårt eget öl. Är du köksmästare eller en erfaren kock redo att ta nästa steg? För oss är titeln mindre viktig, det viktigaste är att du vill vara med och utveckla vårt kök. Vi söker därför en engagerad och driven person som vill vara med och utveckla vårt matkoncept framåt. Vi erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande roll.

**Om tjänsten**

Som köksmästare har du det övergripande ansvaret för kökets dagliga drift, kvalitet och utveckling. Du arbetar både operativt i köket och strategiskt med koncept, ekonomi, personal och är en viktig del av företagets ledningsgrupp.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**

Oavsett om du kommer in som köksmästare eller erfaren kock är du med och sätter nivå, tempo och kvalitet i köket. Du arbetar aktivt med matlagning, förberedelser och service, och är samtidigt med och utvecklar menyer och rätter tillsammans med teamet. Du ansvarar för att leda, planera och schemalägga arbetet i köket samt stötta och utveckla dina kollegor. Du har huvudansvar för: inköp, leverantörskontakter och kostnadskontroll med fokus på att skapa ett lönsamt och välfungerande kök.

Du är med och utvecklar rutiner och arbetssätt för att säkerställa ett effektivt flöde i köket och arbetar enligt gällande hygienkrav och egenkontroll. Tillsammans med restaurangchef och övriga teamet bidrar du till helheten och gästupplevelsen.

**Vi söker dig som**

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet från kök. Du har ett starkt driv och en god ekonomisk förståelse samtidigt som du är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och flexibel. Du har ett stort intresse för mat, kvalitet och utveckling. Vidare är du kommunikativ och behärskar både svenska och engelska. Framför allt brinner du för att skapa en helhetsupplevelse av hög kvalitet.

**Kvalifikationskrav**

Erfarenhet av köksarbete är ett krav och har du erfarenhet från likvärdiga tjänster är det meriterande.

**Anställning**

Köksmästartjänsten är en fast heltidstjänst. Start enligt överenskommelse, så snart som möjligt.

Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Skicka CV och personligt brev till jobb@parkalandia.com ! Intervjuer kommer ske löpande.

Har du frågor kontakta restaurangchef Lizette Ericsson liz@parkalandia.com eller ring 018-14130.
