title: Supply Chain Environment Specialist (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:
The Supply Chain Environmental Specialist supports the development and delivery of Vodafone's environmental strategy across supply chain categories and markets. The role focuses on category-level climate transition planning, supplier engagement, emissions reduction, and capability building within procurement, ensuring purchased goods and services align with Vodafone's 2030 reduction milestones and 2040 Net Zero ambition.
The role sits within Vodafone Procure & Connect (VP&C) in Luxembourg and reports into Vodafone Group's Sustainable Business Team, which sets global sustainability strategy and partners with business units to drive delivery. This is a growing and high-impact area, offering the opportunity to work with sustainability and supply chain experts while engaging a wide range of stakeholders across markets and functions. The role requires a self-driven individual with strong communication and programme management skills, comfortable creating new ways of working.

1. Category climate transition strategies
Support the development of category-specific climate transition plans aligned to Net Zero 2040.
Conduct baseline assessments to identify emissions hotspots, risks, opportunities, and KPIs.
Embed environmental criteria into category planning to support long-term decarbonization.
2. Procurement collaboration & decision-making support
Support the implementation of sustainable procurement processes, including environmental requirements and contract terms.
Partner with category managers to embed carbon reduction targets, environmental KPIs, and climate-aligned supplier selection.
Provide climate data, insights, and analysis to support responsible sourcing decisions.
Support ESG assessments within RFQs, guiding suppliers and integrating results into scoring models.
3. Supplier engagement & performance management
Manage supplier performance against ESG contractual commitments and KPIs.
Drive supplier alignment with Vodafone's environmental targets, reporting, and transition pathways.
Issue and track supplier improvement plans, escalating risks where required.
Participate in supplier reviews to support credible decarbonization and improved environmental performance.
4. Capability building for procurement teams
Deliver training, tools, and guidance to strengthen environmental capability across procurement.
Develop templates, guidance, and onboarding materials covering KPIs, carbon methodologies, and assessments.
Facilitate workshops and learning sessions to embed sustainability into BAU procurement activities.
5. Environmental data, reporting & governance
Support consolidation and validation of supplier climate data for category strategies, CSRD, and internal reporting.
Maintain category-level environmental KPIs and provide progress updates to leadership.
Provide accurate and timely supply chain environmental data to Group Finance.
Who you are
•    A bachelor's degree in Logistics, Materials and Supply Chain Management
•    At least 4 years of experience in Supply Chain
•    Strong project management, analytical skills and comfort working with data.
•    Ability to communicate effectively with suppliers and internal stakeholders, including procurement and finance teams.
•    Proactive, collaborative, and detail oriented approach to problem solving and ability to work independently.
•    Foundational knowledge of procurement processes, category strategies and supplier engagement.
•    Passion for environmental sustainability, climate transition, Scope 3 emissions, and circularity.

Études:
Niveau d'étude demandé egal Bachelor (Bac +3)
Métier / domaine de formation:
Logistics, Materials and Supply Chain Management

title: Cytogeneticist (m/f)
description:
Cytogeneticist (m/f) Ref°49800

TYPE DE CONTRAT : CDI - temps plein

The Laboratoire national de santé (Luxembourg public institution) is recruiting a Cytogeneticist  (m/f)  for a full time (40 h/week) role and permanent  contract at the National Center of Genetics in the Hematooncogenetics-Cytogenetics Service.

ABOUT THE LABORATOIRE NATIONAL DE SANTE

The LNS is a major player in Luxembourg's healthcare sector, serving the country's patients, doctors and hospitals. Under the supervision of the Ministry of Health and Social Security, the LNS is a multidisciplinary public institution organized around six medical departments, two of which are designated as national diagnostic centers for human genetics and pathology respectively.

The LNS employs around 400 highly qualified staff with diverse backgrounds. The main purpose of the LNS is to develop analytical activities and scientific expertise relating to the prevention, diagnosis and monitoring of human diseases; to act as a national control or reference laboratory; and to carry out forensic missions. The LNS also collaborates with the University of Luxembourg and other biomedical research institutions, both nationally and internationally, on research and teaching activities.

In particular, in the field of diagnostics, the LNS covers the following fields of application: medical biology, microbiology, forensic medicine, environmental medicine, morphological and molecular pathology, and clinical genetics, as well as sequencing for rare diseases, oncology and pathogens.

About NATIONAL CENTER OF GENETICS

The NCG at the LNS has approximately 45 employees and is subdivided into three services:

1) Clinical Genetics Service, 2) Hemato-Oncogenetics-Cytogenetics Service, 3) Molecular Genetics Service

The Hemato-Oncogenetics and Cytogenetics team is involved in pre- and postnatal diagnosis (constitutional chromosomal aberrations) and hematooncogenetic diagnosis (acquired aberrations) of patients with hematological neoplasia.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated cytogeneticist to join our dynamic team in the Hematooncogenetics-Cytogenetics service. These tasks await you here:

- Supervise and manage a team of laboratory technicians and scientists in cytogenetics.
- Direct the daily operations of the cytogenetic laboratory
- Develop, validate and implement new procedures and techniques
- Interpret and communicate genetic results to physicians and others health professionals.
- Keep up to date with the latest developments and advances in the field
- Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and guidelines
- Actively participate in the training of medical students, residents and colleagues.
- Participate in the Center's translational research activities.
- Collaborate closely with the other services of the NCG (clinical genetics, molecular genetics and hemato-oncogenetics) and with external partners, in particular healthcare professionals, in order to provide comprehensive patient care and diagnostics of point.
- Represent the NCG at internal and external meetings and conferences as well as in national public health programs and working groups (e.g. the National Rare Disease Program).

Qualifications:

- Medical Doctor certified in medical genetics/cytogenetics, or equivalent
- Eligible to obtain an authorization to practice as a doctor in Luxembourg (Mandatory)

(http://www.sante.public.lu/fr/formulaires/professions/auteuration-exercise-profession-health/index.html)

- At least 5 years of experience in a cytogenetics laboratory (prenatal and postnatal)

- Strong knowledge of (molecular) cytogenetic techniques, including Karyotyping and FISH
- Strong leadership and team management skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Work experience in accredited medical laboratory (ISO 15189) is an advantage.
- Strong IT skills, including proficiency in laboratory IT systems (LIMS).
- Advanced English knowledge in spoken and written is required, knowledge of German or French are an advantage

If you meet the above profile and wish to apply, please submit your application (CV and covering letter) via our website. Your application will be treated confidentially.

At the final stages of the recruitment process, the successful candidate will be asked to provide supporting documentation such as, copies of diplomas and certificates of employment. An official criminal record (bulletin no.3) will also be required for consultation purpose.

title: Head of International Markets (m/f)
description:
Head of International Markets

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction - we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer Luxembourg, you will define and execute the Bank's international business development and market corridor strategy in Asia, the Middle East, the UK and the US. Working closely with the Business Head and Relationship Managers, you will drive disciplined delivery of Net New Money (NNM) and revenue, while safeguarding segment and book purity and ensuring a consistently strong client experience. You will promote HSBC Private Bank Luxembourg as the Booking Centre of choice for HSBC PB's international clients, seeking diversification in Continental Europe. As a senior member within the Luxembourg Front Office management team, you will also be accountable for governance and risk management processes and provide supervisory oversight of business activities.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Own retention and growth of a Luxembourg-based private banking portfolio sourced from key international markets (Asia, Middle East, UK and US).
• Drive deepening across investments, lending and deposits (where applicable), reducing attrition and ensuring appropriate booking governance and book purity for corridor-sourced relationships.
• Run disciplined sales management, including opportunity qualification, pricing/returns focus, and activity standards.
• Establish corridor-to-PBLU portfolio routines (pipeline, attrition watchlist, top-client plans, rebooking/booking exception management).
• Define, refresh and execute the International Markets strategy in close partnership with the Business Heads, including priority client segments, target industries, and value propositions.
• Build and execute PBLU awareness and adoption plan through structured engagement programmes (education series, immersion and exchange visits, regular follow-ups) to deepen understanding of PBLU's platform, offering and capabilities across other HSBC Private Bank booking centres and relevant HSBC lines of business.
• Deliver market financial targets (revenue, margin, profitability, cost-to-serve where applicable), monitor performance drivers (mix, pricing, attrition, productivity), and ensure transparent forecasting by high-quality management information.

You should apply if you have:

• Extensive experience in Private Banking Relationship Management and senior client-facing roles.
• Positive track record in business development and risk management.
• Strong, up-to-date understanding of the market landscape, peer product offering and industry innovation.
• Experience working with clients and teams across Asia, MENA, the UK and the US.
• Demonstrated ability to shape market strategy and multi-year business plans, including footprint/capability design and target setting.
• Strong commercial execution skills, including pipeline management, conversion discipline, pricing/returns focus.
• Strong stakeholder management skills across products, operations, risk, compliance and multiple geographies.
• Fluent English (written and spoken).

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 155,700 - 233,600.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers  

Discover how ‘We Value Difference'.

description:

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.
The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in public health at the bachelor's level and within health-related specialization programmes. The recruited professor will establish teaching and expertise in areas such as epidemiology, health systems, disease prevention, and health policy.
The successful candidate will lead the development and coordination of public health teaching activities across the University's programmes in medicine, nursing sciences, and midwifery. The role includes the implementation of a state-of-the-art public health curriculum, incorporating advanced educational tools such as digital learning platforms, data-driven health simulations, case-based learning, and interactive policy analysis. Working closely with faculty members and clinical partners, the successful candidate will ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students.

Research Portfolio
The candidate is expected to have an internationally recognised research profile and to bring a coherent research programme in public health. The candidate will develop and lead an ambitious research agenda in areas such as population health, primary care, prevention, health systems, epidemiology, health inequalities, data driven health sciences, and digital health.

Policy and Practice Integration
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in public health research and/or practice, with a commitment to integrating real-world perspectives into education. This will enhance the practical application of public health principles in healthcare and policy contexts. The possibility of maintaining collaborative activities with national health authorities or international organizations may be considered, depending on the candidate's profile and institutional partnerships.

For further information about the role, please contact: Serge Haan, Head of DHML, Email: serge.haan@uni.lu


Your profile
• MD/PhD or PhD in Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Systems, or a closely related field. An MD is considered an asset
• Extensive experience in public health research and/or practice, ideally with a strong track record in population health, primary care, health policy, or health systems analysis
• Substantial teaching experience in public health, epidemiology, or health sciences at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels, preferably within medical, nursing, or life sciences programs
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching, particularly in integrating public health with medicine, life sciences, and nursing
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement new educational courses, including modules on health systems, epidemiology, and preventive strategies
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, such as online learning platforms, simulation-based training, data-driven case studies, and interactive policy analysis

Language requirements
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. However, a strong command of French is considered a significant asset. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to Serge Haan, Head of DHML
• CV, including any periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications, projects, teaching expertise and accomplishments in knowledge transfer relevant to this role (1-3 pages)
• Statement of planned research, teaching and other activities at the University of Luxembourg (1–3 pages)
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught
• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
We encourage early application. Applications are only accepted online through the HR system. The position will be unposted on 24th September 2026, after which no further applications can be submitted. Applications will be handled in strict confidence.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.
Diversity and gender equality
The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

Support and verify execution of containment actions at suppliers.
Support execution of containment actions at Supplier
Contribute to Root Cause Analysis and Permanent Corrective Action determination and follow-up on implementation at supplier.

Support new supplier qualification.

Strong Quality background required. Good understanding of Quality needs (e.g., what internal/external suppliers provide, what customers expect, and what performance measurement metrics are)
Understanding of tools and processes related to Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP); ability to facilitate sessions with partners.

Strong project and change management skills.
Hands-on data collection and analysis skills, with a high attention to detail

Excellent problem-solving skills and tenacity to drive the resolution to conclusion.
Understanding of lean principles to enhance quality process design and operations.
Understands the need and benefit of Quality Assurance
Understanding of ISO Quality Management System requirements & business/industry standards
Excellent written and spoken command of English and German, additional languages are a plus.
Audit capabilities, Audit skill & knowledge, good relationship skills
Good understanding of Husky's product design, standards, and manufacturing technologies for a wide range of product types; process engineering can be generic/agnostic of product.
Travel required at Supplier (25%)

title: Senior Fund Legal Counsel – UCITS, Prospectus Drafting & CSSF Regulatory Projects (m/f)
description:
Senior Fund Legal Counsel – UCITS, Prospectus Drafting & CSSF Regulatory Projects

Join Fundsight in Luxembourg and take ownership of high-impact UCITS product development, prospectus drafting and CSSF submissions for international clients.

Location: Luxembourg, Cloche d'Or | Languages: Fluent English and French required | Seniority: Senior legal role within a regulated Management Company and AIFM

About Fundsight

Fundsight S.A. is an independent Luxembourg Management Company and AIFM providing fund governance, regulatory and administration solutions to an international client base of asset managers, investment funds and institutional sponsors. As a regulated third-party ManCo operating in a demanding and fast-moving market, we offer our people direct exposure to sophisticated fund structures, high-quality clients and meaningful regulatory projects.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Fund Legal Counsel – UCITS, Prospectus Drafting & CSSF Regulatory Projects to join our expanding legal team and play a visible role in the continued development of our Luxembourg platform.

This role is primarily dedicated to UCITS product development, prospectus drafting, fund documentation and CSSF regulatory submissions across the full lifecycle of Luxembourg investment funds. You will lead complex legal and regulatory projects, advise international clients and act as a key point of contact for the CSSF, service providers and internal stakeholders.

The position combines technical fund law expertise, client-facing advisory work and hands-on project management. It is designed for a lawyer who enjoys taking ownership, working close to the business and contributing to the growth of a modern, entrepreneurial and internationally connected Management Company.

Your Role

UCITS Product Development & Fund Documentation

• Lead the drafting, review and coordination of UCITS prospectuses and related fund documentation.

• Take responsibility for legal and regulatory workstreams relating to:

o Fund launches;
o Sub-fund launches;
o Share class creations;
o Mergers;
o Liquidations;
o Restructurings;
o Investment policy amendments;
o Fee, governance and operational changes; and
o Other events requiring CSSF approval, notification or regulatory filing.

• Coordinate updates to articles of incorporation, management regulations and other key fund documentation.
• Liaise with clients, investment managers, depositaries, administrators, distributors, external counsel and other service providers throughout project implementation.

Alternative Investment Funds

• Review and coordinate legal documentation relating to AIFs and alternative investment structures, while the main drafting focus remains on UCITS documentation.
• Support projects involving RAIFs, SIFs, SICARs and other alternative investment vehicles.

CSSF Affairs & Regulatory Filings

• Prepare, coordinate and oversee CSSF submissions relating primarily to UCITS funds and, where relevant, AIF structures.
• Act as a primary contact during regulatory approval processes and CSSF follow-up requests.
• Manage fund lifecycle regulatory filings and ensure timely completion of regulatory obligations.
• Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting Luxembourg investment funds and assess their impact on existing structures and documentation.

Legal Review & Contractual Matters

• Review, negotiate and coordinate fund-related agreements.
• Support the onboarding and oversight of service providers and distribution networks.
• Provide practical and commercially focused legal advice to clients and internal stakeholders.

Client & Project Management

• Act as a trusted legal advisor for a portfolio of international clients.
• Lead complex legal and regulatory projects from inception through implementation.
• Coordinate effectively with regulators, clients, service providers and internal teams across multiple jurisdictions.
• Ensure high-quality delivery under demanding regulatory and commercial deadlines.

Candidate Profile

Education & Experience

• Master's Degree in Law or an equivalent legal qualification.
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience gained within:

o A Luxembourg Management Company;
o An AIFM;
o A law firm; or
o A specialised investment fund services provider.

• Proven experience in UCITS prospectus drafting, CSSF approval processes and Luxembourg fund lifecycle events is essential.
• Experience managing fund lifecycle events and regulatory projects is highly desirable.
Technical Expertise

Strong knowledge of:

• UCITS regulation and Luxembourg investment fund law;
• Fund governance and lifecycle events;
• CSSF regulatory requirements and approval processes; and
• Alternative investment fund structures, including RAIFs, SIFs and SICARs.
Knowledge of French and/or Belgian investment fund regulation would be considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

• Excellent legal drafting and analytical skills.
• Strong project management and organisational abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple complex matters simultaneously.
• Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.
• Client-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness.
• High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
• Ability to work autonomously whilst collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Languages

• Fluent English (written and spoken).
• Fluent French (written and spoken).
• Ability to draft and review legal documentation in both languages.

Why Join Fundsight?

• Take ownership of sophisticated UCITS legal and regulatory projects from structuring to launch.
• Draft and manage prospectuses and key fund documentation for international asset managers and fund sponsors.
• Work at the heart of CSSF approval processes, regulatory filings and fund lifecycle events.
• Join a growing, entrepreneurial and independent Luxembourg Management Company and AIFM.
• Benefit from direct client exposure, visible responsibility and close interaction with senior decision-makers.
• Collaborate with experienced professionals across legal, compliance, risk, oversight and business development functions.
• Work from modern offices in Cloche d'Or, Luxembourg, in the heart of a dynamic business district.
• Enjoy flexible working arrangements, a teleworking policy, lunch vouchers and additional private health insurance.
• Gain international exposure through leading asset managers, investment funds and institutional clients.
• Develop your career in a role combining technical excellence, business proximity and long-term growth opportunities.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a commercially minded investment funds lawyer with strong technical expertise in Luxembourg UCITS, proven experience in prospectus drafting and a solid understanding of CSSF approval processes. The ideal candidate is precise, pragmatic and client-oriented, with the ability to manage several complex matters in parallel while maintaining high-quality standards.
If you are ready to take a visible senior role in UCITS product development and regulatory projects within a growing Luxembourg ManCo/AIFM, we would be pleased to hear from you.

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level

• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer

• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

description:
CFO HSBC Investment Funds (Luxembourg) S.A.

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our Asset Management business.

What you will do:

Reporting functionally to the Asset Management Continental Europe CFO and locally to the CEO of HSBC Investment Funds Luxembourg (HIFL), you will head the Finance function for HIFL, the HIFL Ireland Branch and the HIFL UAE Branch. You will ensure consistently high standards of financial control, reporting and executive insight. You will be a key member of the HIFL Local Management Committee and a standing attendee at key governance forums, presenting the HIFL's financial position to senior stakeholders.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Head the Finance function across HIFL Luxembourg, HIFL Ireland Branch and HIFL UAE Branch, setting a high bar for financial control, reporting quality and decision support for executive stakeholders.
• Deliver accurate, timely and compliant Group reporting, producing clear, executive-ready MI and ad hoc insight for stakeholders including the AMEU CFO.
• Own end-to-end statutory reporting: prepare IFRS financial statements aligned to Asset Management standards and maintain strong ledger integrity, including oversight of postings to the HIFL ledger.
• Direct the audit cycle end-to-end, coordinating auditors to meet all deliverables on time and to a high standard.
• Drive a robust balance sheet and cost base: ensure reconciliations are complete and well-evidenced; oversee operational budgets for fund ranges; maintain accurate accruals and invoice governance, keeping forecasts aligned to business changes.
• Provide effective financial stewardship and risk oversight: submit local regulatory returns; validate management fee calculations and intercompany payaways to ensure fair revenue allocation across AMG sites; act as TPEM and/or Risk Steward for suppliers where applicable.

You should apply if you have:

• Relevant professional accountancy qualification (e.g., ACA / ACCA / CA / CPA or equivalent).
• Strong experience in asset management, financial services, audit and/or private wealth management, with senior accountability for financial control and reporting.
• Deep knowledge of IFRS and financial statement preparation. Knowledge of Lux GAAP and Luxembourg regulatory reporting requirements is an advantage.
• Strong leadership capability, including oversight of offshore/outsourced teams and delivery through a matrix environment.
• Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical matters to non-specialists and senior stakeholders.
• Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 116,900 – 140,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Meet your future team

Join the International Corporate Tax team within Tax Product Services (TPS), where you will work alongside tax specialists supporting alternative investment clients, including private equity, real estate and hedge fund structures. title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and environment we live in.
The Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) is dedicated to advancing health and improving quality of life through excellence in research, education, and clinical engagement. Responsive to national health priorities and connected to international networks, our researchers address major challenges in human health - from fundamental discoveries to professional practice. The University of Luxembourg has set a strategic focus on medicine and health and is actively developing the training and research areas in these domains, creating exceptional opportunities in medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The successful candidate will contribute to the strategic development and continuous advancement of the University's Medical Specialisation Programmes. The candidate will assist Directors of Studies in developing research ideas, preparing competitive project proposals and funding applications, analysing scientific and educational developments, and translating research outcomes into programme enhancement and innovation. The candidate will work closely with the Directors of Studies, academic and administrative staff, as well as other internal and external institutional stakeholders.

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Computer Science (DCS) conducts cutting-edge research and offers high-quality education in core areas of computer science, with particular strengths in artificial intelligence, information security, and advanced computing systems. DCS promotes interdisciplinary research and closely cooperates with other high-profile research centers in Luxembourg and beyond, as well as with industry and society. While the primary focus will be on top-tier General Partners, this role also spans a broader client base including private credit platforms, real asset managers, venture capital firms, secondaries investors, and fund-of-funds.

You will operate as a strategic hunter, leveraging an existing network across private markets to engage both economic and technical buyers including Group Financial Controllers, CFOs, Finance Directors, Heads of Operations, Head of Compliance, Investor Relations and Finance Transformation leaders.
You will play a critical role in shaping how private markets participants across fund managers and adjacent structures, adopt next-generation infrastructure, driving standardisation, efficiency, and liquidity across the ecosystem.

Proven track record selling into the private market's ecosystem, including but not limited to:  

• General Partners (GPs) across private equity, private credit, real assets, and venture capital  
• Mid-market and emerging managers  
• Secondaries investors and platforms  
• Fund-of-funds and multi-manager platforms  
• Institutional investors (LPs) including pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and asset managers (where relevant to fund operations and infrastructure)  
• Private markets service providers, including fund administrators, custodians, and outsourced finance providers  
Established network across senior stakeholders within private markets, with demonstrable access to decision-makers across both fund managers and the wider ecosystem  

Demonstrated ability to engage and close with:  

• Technical buyers (Fund Operations, Finance Transformation, Middle Office, Fund Accounting, and Systems/Technology stakeholders)  
• Economic buyers (CFO, Group Financial Controller, Finance Director, Operating Partner level)  
• Experience selling complex, high-value solutions such as financial infrastructure, fund administration, data platforms, or fintech solutions into sophisticated financial institutions  
• Strong understanding of how different participants across private markets interact operationally (GP–LP relationships, fund administrators, intermediaries), and where inefficiencies or friction points exist

Commercial Profile

• True “hunter” mentality with a relationship-first approach  
• Established track record in selling to economic buyers across private markets
• Strong commercial judgement and experience structuring enterprise-level deals  
• Ability to position solutions at both strategic and operational levels  

Strong understanding of:  

• Private markets fund structures (LP's and GP's)  
• Operational workflows across finance, middle office, and fund administration  
• Demonstrated ability to interpret and communicate financial and operational value propositions to senior stakeholders  
• High level of commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to engage in value-based and ROI-driven discussions

Personal Attributes

• Highly credible with senior finance stakeholders  
• Strong presence and ability to operate as a peer to client leadership  
• Naturally network-driven with a reputation in the market  
• Intellectually curious with a strong understanding of private markets structures and workflows

Compensation:

• Industry leading base salary - EUR 150,000 - 200,000 depending on experience
• 10% commissions on all sales, payable in monthly instalments, starting month 1 from deal completion
 
Qualifications:  

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field (preferred but not essential with relevant experience)  
• Advanced qualifications such as ACA / ACCA / CFA / MBA are advantageous, particularly for credibility with senior finance stakeholders  
 
Being part of Sonata One provides a collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation and diversity. We believe in the power of our unique mission and we all work together towards that one single goal. We also believe in being real. We're not a big corporate. Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

Describe the main responsibilities of the position.

Refrigeration and air conditioning account for ~17% of global energy consumption, a figure expected to triple by 2050, while contributing over 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions. Conventional vapor-compression cooling relies on high–global-warming-potential refrigerants, creating an urgent need for energy-efficient and environmentally friendly alternatives. Electrocaloric cooling is a promising solid-state technology that can be up to 20% more efficient than vapor-compression systems. It uses ferroelectric materials that undergo a reversible temperature change under an applied electric field. The materials heats upon application and cools upon removal of an electric field. LIST has been working on the topic for some years, specifically developing electrocaloric prototypes based on ceramics and polymers. LIST is recognized as one of the leading institutes in the field.

The role played by materials thermal conductivity on the behaviour of electrocaloric coolers is central to enable a proper understanding of the system. Therefore, this post doc is about studying the thermal conductivity of electrocaloric materials in the context of cooling devices. More specifically, one part will be devoted to the design and fabrication of heat exchangers integrated in electrocaloric coolers. The impact of materials and their thickness will be assessed in specific devices. Another part of this post doc will be devoted to the study of heat switches associated with electrocaloric materials, enabling the design of fluid-free cooling devices.

title: Medior asset management professional
description:
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement
Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van analyses, implementaties of verbetertrajecten
Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden
Je schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projecten
je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,
je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passen
afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen
klantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatie

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

title: Aankomend landmeter / maatvoerder gezocht
description:
Om het landmeten goed te leren ga je met een ervaren landmeter op pad om hem te assisteren bij zijn werkzaamheden. Denk hierbij aan waterpassen, detailmetingen, maatvoeren, metingen uitvoeren. Mocht je het werk als junior landmeter ontzettend leuk vinden en ben je een snelle leerling, dan zijn er doorgroeimogelijkheden voor je om uiteindelijk zelfstandig aan de slag te gaan als volwaardig landmeter.
Verdere werkzaamheden o.a. verwerken/bewerken van ingewonnen of aangeleverde gegevens, aanleveren van gevraagde informatie, gebruiken en onderhouden van alle apparatuur die bij de metingen wordt gebruikt en zorgen dat deze apparatuur hiervoor aanwezig is.
Bedrijfsprofiel: Geonique beschikt over een unieke kennis, ervaring en expertise op het gebied van infrastructurele en bouwkundige projecten. Ieder bouwwerk is maatwerk en juist dit is ons specialisme. Op het gebied van geodesie (zowel op land als op het water) dragen wij zorg voor het inwinnen, verwerken, uitzetten, bewerken, analyseren, optimaliseren, creëren en presenteren van 3D-geodata. Het inwinnen gebeurd met de meest moderne apparatuur. Naast terreinmetingen en inmetingen van bestaande infra vertaald Geonique ook het ontwerp naar het veld door het verzorgen van uitzetwerk of de modellen voor GPS- machinebesturing. Tevens ondersteunen wij ook industrie, utiliteits en woningsbouwprojecten met onze kennis op gebied van maatvoering. Denk hierbij aan het inmeten of uitzetten van funderingen, staalconstructies, sonderingen, boringen, gevels of inpandige metingen.

Deze klant is een maatschappelijk betrokken familiebedrijf in Leiden, opgericht in 1945 als een diagnostisch bedrijf, is momenteel marktleider in de industrie voor in-vitrodiagnostiek. Zij investeert in onderzoek en innovatie om nieuwe en beter presterende reagentia, systemen en oplossingen voor hemostase en trombose te ontwikkelen. Met meer dan 80 jaar ervaring is zij een wereldwijde referentie in hemostase en een 1e klas partner voor biomedische laboratoria. Deze organisatie heeft ca. 2.600 FTE en is vertegenwoordigd in meer dan 110 landen via haar filialen en een uitgebreid distributienetwerk. De diversiteit van mannen en vrouwen, beroepen en knowhow is wat haar in staat stelt om het breedste assortiment reagentia- en hemostase-instrumenten over de hele wereld te ontwikkelen, produceren en verkopen met behulp van de meest geavanceerde technologieën. Klanttevredenheid is daarbij een belangrijke waarde en iedereen is zich ervan bewust dat er een patiënt achter hun acties zit.
Het bedrijfsonderdeel BNL is in 2011 ontstaan na een overname en biedt ondersteuning aan haar klanten in Nederland en Vlaanderen. Het team bestaat uit 19 medewerkers en het kantoor is gevestigd te Leiden.

Het varieert van een strak keukeneiland tot een kantoorinrichting of een op maat gemaakt wandmeubel voor een restaurant. Wij tekenen, wij bouwen, wij zorgen dat het klopt. Op kantoor werkt iedereen met dezelfde software, zodat tekeningen meteen in de werkplaats gebruikt kunnen worden. Overleg is kort en praktisch. Perfect, want wij houden van spannende uitdagingen in plaats van saaie rechte hoeken. Zo wordt elke dag afwisselend, praktisch én creatief.

Regular plant care in industrial settings should be performed according to a structured maintenance schedule that varies by system type and operational demands. Critical systems require daily monitoring, while comprehensive maintenance typically occurs weekly to monthly. The frequency depends on equipment complexity, operating conditions, and regulatory requirements. Effective plant care combines preventive maintenance, routine inspections, and system optimization to ensure reliable operations. What does regular plant care actually involve?
Regular plant care encompasses comprehensive maintenance activities, including preventive maintenance, routine inspections, equipment servicing, and system optimization. This approach focuses on identifying and addressing potential issues before they cause operational disruptions or safety concerns.
The fundamental difference between reactive and proactive maintenance approaches defines successful plant care strategies. Reactive maintenance responds to equipment failures after they occur, often resulting in costly downtime and emergency repairs. Proactive plant care involves scheduled maintenance activities, continuous monitoring, and systematic inspections that prevent failures before they happen.

title: Account Manager
description:
Ben jij de accountmanager die nieuwe kansen om zet naar langdurige relaties? Lees dan snel verder.

G-Nius zoekt een enthousiaste accountmanager:

Als Account Manager ben je commercieel gedreven, ondernemend, energiek, verkoop- en resultaatgericht. Daarbij beschik je over een flinke dosis doorzettingsvermogen. Je bent een verbinder, je genereert ideeën en zoekt naar creatieve mogelijkheden om nieuwe opdrachtgevers aan G-Nius te binden. Je werkt proactief aan een solide en langdurige samenwerking met zowel opdrachtgevers als met professionals.

Daarnaast ben je continu op zoek naar het maken van de perfecte match tussen professionals en opdrachtgevers. Je maakt hiervoor gebruik van jouw eigen netwerk als het zakelijk netwerk van G-Nius.

Wat ga je doen?

Bij G-Nius ben je als Sales Consultant actief in een 360 graden rol. Je draagt de zorg en verantwoordelijkheid voor het beheer van jouw relatiebestand. Dit bestand bestaat voornamelijk uit opdrachtgevers binnen de ICT-, Logistiek- en Managementomgeving.

Hiernaast ben je de verbinding tussen onze professionals en opdrachtgevers waarbij kwaliteit en open communicatie hoog in het vaandel staat. Dit doe je door in gesprek te gaan en de wensen en behoeften van beide partijen in kaart te brengen. Alleen zo kan je als Account Manager maatwerk bieden.

Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden bestaan uit:

Verkoopbeheer, accountbeheer en relatiebeheer.
Resourcemanagement.
Acquisitie new business.
Analyseren van personele behoefte, processen en wensen van de klant en deze vertalen in praktische oplossingen.
Commerciële activiteiten, zoals het voeren van verkoopgesprekken, het uitbrengen van offertes, het onderhandelen over en afsluiten van contracten.
Werving van professionals.
Voeren van sollicitatiegesprekken.
Interim- en Recruitment.
Contactpunt voor klant en professional.


Werken als Account Manager IT Detachering bij G-Nius

G-Nius is een onderneming waar een informele maar professionele sfeer heerst. We vinden openheid en betrokkenheid belangrijk.

We bieden je een zelfstandig functie binnen een jong en enthousiast team waar eigen initiatieven vanzelfsprekend zijn. Wanneer je er even niet uitkomt staan je collega's voor je klaar om ondersteuning te bieden.

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat ons team een hecht team is. Daarom lunchen wij altijd samen. Na de lunch lopen we een rondje door de binnenstad van s-Hertogenbosch om de middag weer vol goede energie te beginnen. Daarnaast organiseren wij leuke evenementen om elkaar, ook buiten kantoor, beter te leren kennen. Wil je meer weten over werken bij G-Nius? Kijk dan op www.werkenbijg-nius.nl.

title: Cleaning Employee
description:
Enjoy a job on the coast of Zeeland. You enjoy making the holiday homes look clean and tidy again. As part of the MVH cleaning team you work in Cadzand, at a beautiful holiday park. The accommodations are gorgeous holiday homes. You are available every Monday and/or Friday. With our bus you can be picked up and drive to Cadzand-Bad to deliver the houses spick and span from 10.00 to 16.00 o'clock.

You go to the location with your team to work in Cadzand with one of our buses or cars. We have pick-up points in Hulst, Axel, Koewacht and Terneuzen. You clean the houses quickly and good, so that the new guests can enjoy their well-deserved vacation. The work includes vacuuming, cleaning wet areas, dusting, removing beds and possibly cleaning a window if it is too dirty.

Do you have an eye for cleanliness, are you meticulous and do you see what others do not see? Register now and join our fun and hard working pool of employees and get to work with your colleagues in Cadzand.

You work on Mondays and/or Fridays from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM in Cadzand. If you are asked to continue working a little longer or an extra day, that is of course no problem for you.

The CAO recreation does not reimburse travel time and travel costs. However, MVH offers you 2 hour extra pay, when you drive a bus or car with collegues!

As a Warehouse Worker at CB (Centraal Boekhuis) in Culemborg, you will be right in the middle of the action, handling millions of books every single day! What will you do

- Collect book orders seamlessly using a smart, digital pick-to-light system 💡

Over ons

Stichting Apna Kinderopvang is een professionele kinderopvangorganisatie gevestigd in Den Haag. Liefdevolle zorg en de juiste begeleiding voor elk kind staan bij ons centraal. Begrippen als tolerantie, zorg, respect en kennis staan bij Apna hoog in het vaandel en vormen een vast onderdeel van ons pedagogisch beleid. Zo leggen wij samen een stevige basis voor de toekomstmogelijkheden van elk kind in de maatschappij.

Wat ga je doen als Pedagogisch medewerker?

Als Pedagogisch medewerker kinderopvang begeleid en verzorg je groepen kinderen van nul tot twaalf jaar. Je begeleidt kinderen in hun dagelijkse leefsituatie en bij hun persoonlijke verzorging. Je draagt eveneens zorg voor lichte huishoudelijke werkzaamheden en voor een schone, veilige ruimte waar de kinderen verblijven. Je onderneemt actieve, ontwikkelingsgerichte en creatieve activiteiten met de kinderen.

  • Je bent flexibel, enthousiast en betrokken

  • Je bent in het bezit van een kwalificerend diploma (mbo/bachelor) conform de Nederlandse cao-richtlijnen. Een kwalificerend Vlaams diploma in de richting van zorg, welzijn of pedagogiek (een diploma-check wordt door ons gefaciliteerd via de Nederlandse cao-richtlijnen)

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal verplicht op minimaal niveau B2 / 3F (mondeling en schriftelijk)

  • Je beschikt over een babyscholingscertificaat (of bent bereid dit te behalen voor de dagopvang)

  • Je hebt aantoonbare pedagogische kennis en kennis van de geldende hygiëne- en veiligheidseisen

  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar op werkdagen tussen 07.00 en 19.00 uur (maximaal 9 uur per dag)

  • Je bezit sterke sociale vaardigheden voor het motiveren van kinderen en het onderhouden van helder contact met ouders.

title: Ilmoitusmyyjä etätyö
description:
Haemme etätyöntekijöiksi vakituisia ilmoitusmyyjiä, jotka myyvät ilmoitustilaa eri järjestöjen lehtiin. Järjestölehtiä meillä on monelta eri alalta. Esimerkkeinä poliisin ja viranomaisten eri järjestöt, Opaskoirayhdistys, Sydänlapset ja monia muita. Kaiken kaikkiaan edustamme noin 50 eri yhdistystä.

Maksamme palkan kerran viikossa. Meillä voi työskennellä verokirjalla, kevytyrittäjänä ja omalla yrityksellä.

Tässä hieman tietoa järjestölehdistä:

https://www.sttinfo.fi/tiedote/69927469/jarjestolehti-voi-olla-tuottoisa?publisherId=69819118 https://issuu.com/printmixoy

https://www.yhdistyslehdet.fi https://printmixoyhelsinki.wordpress.com/

Et tarvitse alan aikaisempaa kokemusta, koulutamme tehtävään.

Odotamme sinulta myyntihenkisyyttä, ahkeruutta ja rehtiä suhtautumista työhön. Työ edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa. Aikaisempi kokemus puhelinmyyjä- ja telemarkkinointityöstä on eduksi.

Tarjoamme mukavan myytävän tuotteen, nykyaikaiset työkalut, ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työympäristön.

Kyseessä on päivätyö, jota voi tehdä 8.00–18.00 välisenä aikana arkisin.

Työtä voi suorittaa kokopäivätyönä tai osapäivätyönä.

Tarjoamme sinulle hyvän palkan ja hyvät puitteet työn suorittamiseen. Järjestämme säännöllisesti myös myyntikilpailuja, jotka antavat mukavaa virettä tekemiseen. Myyntipäällikkömme auttavat työntekemisessä koko ajan.

Arvostamme hyviä työntekijöitä, pidämme työntekijöistämme hyvän huolen.

Soita heti tai lähetä meille hakemuksesi Hae työpaikkaa -painikkeen kautta.

title: Persoonlijk begeleider voor Haagsittard
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Levantogroep een Persoonlijk begeleider voor de locatie Haagsittard.

Hoeve Haagsittard biedt een veilige, beschermde woonomgeving voor volwassenen met psychiatrische en/of meervoudige problematiek. Met begeleiding wordt toegewerkt naar meer structuur in de dag en indien mogelijk, zelfstandigheid. 
De locatie beschikt over drie gemeenschappelijke woonkamers met keuken waar de bewoners elkaar ontmoeten. De locatie heeft 34 kamers, allen met een eigen toilet en doucheruimte. Gelegen op een rustige plek aan de rand van een woonwijk, beschikt hoeve Haagsittard over een prachtige binnenplaats, waar het lekker vertoeven is met elkaar. 

Er wordt gewerkt in wisselende diensten incl. weekenden en feestdagen. 

Dit is waar jij blij van wordt
Je zet je in om mensen te ondersteunen zodat ze kunnen deelnemen aan de maatschappij.  

Als persoonlijk begeleider Haagsittard heb je de volgende taken en verantwoordelijkheden: 

  • Het ondersteunen van de cliënten bij opstellen van een individueel actieplan, het samen vaststellen van doelen en het bijstellen hiervan.   

  • Begeleiden en individueel ondersteunen van de cliënten. Bijvoorbeeld bij aspecten op sociaal gebied of op het gebied van dag invulling / participatie.    

  • Je beheert je eigen caseload en je neemt deel aan teamkrachtbesprekingen.    

  • Het geven van trainingen aan cliënten op het gebied van wonen is een onderdeel van de functie (woontraining).     

Daarnaast waarderen we het als je een bijdrage wil leveren aan de ontwikkelingen binnen de organisatie.

Dit is LEVANTOgroep!

Wij bieden ondersteuning op gebied van geestelijke gezondheid en maatschappelijke opvang in Zuid- en Midden-Limburg in de vorm van ambulante begeleiding, beschermd wonen, crisisopvang, vrouwenopvang en participatie voor zowel jongeren als volwassenen. Zodat cliënten het heft weer in eigen hand kunnen nemen en als volwaardig burger deel uit kunnen maken van de maatschappij.

Een enthousiaste collega met LEV en die nét zo'n hart heeft voor onze cliënten als wij hebben. Dit kenmerkt jou: 

  • Je bent in het bezit van een relevant mbo-4/hbo zorgdiploma en hebt affiniteit met onze doelgroep. Ervaring in psychiatrie en verslaving is een extra troef. 

  • Je begeleidt cliënten door onze kernwaarde LEV toe te passen. Ervaring met krachtgericht methodisch werken is een pluspunt. Net als kennis van psychopathologie. 

  • Je bent in het bezit van eigen vervoer. 

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen. 

  • Je kan cliënten motiveren, omgaan met weerstand en daadkrachtig handelen in ad-hoc situaties. 

  • Je bent handig in schriftelijke verslaglegging en digitale systemen is een vereiste. 

  • Je bent stressbestendig, pro-actief en flexibel. 

  • Je hebt kennis van de sociale kaart en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Levantogroep een helpende plus voor de locatie Rijckhof.

Op Rijckhof bieden we een veilige woonomgeving met 24-uurs ondersteuning voor ouder wordende cliënten die behoefte hebben aan zowel psychische ondersteuning als somatische zorg in een beschermende omgeving. 

Als Helpende Plus bied je de ondersteuning die de cliënt nodig heeft om op alle levensgebieden zo optimaal mogelijk te functioneren. Je werkt vanuit een methodiek die uitgaat van de eigen kracht van de cliënt.

De werktijden zijn van maandag t/m zondag tussen 7.15-23 uur (uren per dag in overleg).

De locatie Rijckhof is niet bereikbaar met openbaar vervoer.  


Dit is waar jij blij van wordt

Je zet je in om mensen te ondersteunen zodat zij zo zelfstandig mogelijk kunnen functioneren en deelnemen aan de maatschappij.

Als helpende plus bij Rijckhof heb je de volgende taken en verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Het verrichten van persoonsgerichte verzorging en ondersteuning bij alledaagse levensverrichtingen (ADL).
  • Het bijdragen aan een prettige en veilige woonsfeer.
  • Het verzorgen en begeleiden van dagactiviteiten.
  • Het ondersteunen bij eetmomenten en de daarbij behorende keukenwerkzaamheden.
  • Het verrichten van huishoudelijke werkzaamheden.
  • Het uitvoeren van medicatie gerelateerde handelingen binnen de geldende bevoegdheden, protocollen en bekwaamheidseisen.
  • Het ondersteunen bij eenvoudige verpleegtechnische handelingen passend binnen jouw opleiding, instructie en bekwaamheid.
  • Het uitvoeren van aanvullende zorghandelingen, zoals wondverzorging, stomazorg, katheterzorg, blaasspoelen en het toedienen van medicatie en/of insuline, voor zover je hiervoor bevoegd en bekwaam bent.
  • Het signaleren van bijzonderheden rondom medicatiegebruik, gezondheid en welzijn van cliënten en hierover rapporteren aan de verantwoordelijke zorgprofessional.
  • Het bijdragen aan een veilige uitvoering van medicatieprocessen binnen de locatie.
  • Het verrichten van overige voorkomende werkzaamheden.

Daarnaast waarderen we het als je een actieve bijdrage levert aan ontwikkelingen binnen de organisatie.

Een enthousiaste collega met LEV die nét zo'n hart heeft voor onze cliënten als wij.

Dit kenmerkt jou:

  • Je bent in het bezit van een diploma Helpende Zorg en Welzijn (mbo niveau 2), aangevuld met een erkende Helpende Plus-certificering.
  • Je bent aantoonbaar bevoegd en bekwaam voor het uitvoeren van medicatie gerelateerde handelingen en aanvullende zorghandelingen.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met onze doelgroep. Ervaring binnen de GGZ of maatschappelijke opvang is een pré.
  • Je begeleidt cliënten vanuit onze kernwaarde LEV. Ervaring met krachtgericht methodisch werken is een pré, evenals kennis van psychopathologie.
  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen en kunt omgaan met complexe situaties.
  • Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken.
  • Je beschikt over goede sociale vaardigheden, kunt goed luisteren en hebt een sterk empathisch vermogen.
  • Je bent in staat cliënten te motiveren en te stimuleren in hun herstelproces.
  • Je bent zorgvuldig en alert bij het uitvoeren van medicatie- en zorghandelingen.

title: Omscholen tot rijinstructeur? LesGO zoekt rijinstructeurs!
description:

LesGO Academie verzorgt jouw korte omscholing tot rijinstructeur binnen 4 tot 6 maanden, afhankelijk van hoe snel jij wilt. Vraag zelfs naar de mogelijkheden om je opleiding te laten bekostigen! Vooraf krijg je (na een intake) de baangarantie zwart op wit, zodat je direct aansluitend na je opleiding direct aan het werk kunt, bij een van de verkeersscholen in ons relatienetwerk of bij een verkeersschool naar je eigen keuze. Bij ons ben je daarin helemaal vrij en we helpen je graag daar waar jij dat nodig vindt. Kortom, een unieke (tweede?) kans voor een mooie en leuke baan. 50 plus juist ook meer dan welkom!

LesGO is een jonge, dynamische organisatie die gaat voor het beste. Wanneer wij een samenwerking aangaan kun je rekenen op een prettige communicatie en een goede ondersteuning. LesGO investeert blijvend in haar ondernemers. Denk aan het continu aanleveren van nieuwe leerlingen, landelijke marketingactiviteiten, het blijvend verbeteren van het rijschoolconcept en een administratieve ondersteuning . Dat maakt ons vaak een stap sneller dan de concurrent en dit zie je terug in de verdiensten!  Nog niet de juiste papieren, maar wil je wel rijinstructeur worden? Haal dan je papieren via de LesGO Academie. Let op: in sommige gevallen wordt de opleiding vergoed door de uitkerende instantie. Vraag ons naar de mogelijkheden voor uw traject.

title: Hydroloog & Geo-Data Developer
description:
- Een afgeronde WO-opleiding in hydrologie, (geo-)hydrologie, fysische geografie, earth sciences of vergelijkbaar.
- Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in zelfstandige hydrologische modellering en/of geo-data engineering.
- Ervaring met SWAP-modellering, Hydrus, inclusief kalibratie en batchuitvoer.
- Werkervaring met Python voor data- en modelautomatisering (pandas, geopandas, rasterio).
- Praktische ervaring met Flask of vergelijkbare frameworks, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, en het bouwen van eenvoudige REST API's voor het ontsluiten van spatial data.
- Werkervaring met QGIS en/of ArcGIS, inclusief scripting waar nodig.
- Vaardigheid met frontend-visualisatie via Leaflet, Chart.js of vergelijkbare bibliotheken.
- Communicatievaardigheden in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk (minimaal B2).  
- Een zelfstandige werkhouding, je levert end-to-end op zonder dagelijkse aansturing.

AtlaTerra is een onafhankelijk onderzoeks- en adviesbureau op het gebied van bodem, water en klimaat. In het kleine Nederland is de beschikbare ruimte beperkt. De ruimtelijke gebruiksfuncties zoals landbouw, natuur, stedelijk gebied en infrastructuur zijn hierdoor sterk verweven. De optimale waterhuishoudkundige omstandigheden voor deze ruimtelijke functies kunnen sterk van elkaar verschillen waardoor tegengestelde belangen kunnen ontstaan. Om deze tegengestelde belangen te overbruggen kan onafhankelijk onderzoek en advies een belangrijke rol spelen.
Wij zijn een klein, onafhankelijk bureau in het Nederlandse waterbeheer. We werken voor opdrachtgevers zoals Waterschappen, provincies en agrarische adviesorganisaties. Korte lijnen, zelfstandig vakmanschap, geen lange overlegtrajecten.

De rol: We zoeken een hydroloog/geo-data specialist die zelfstandig opdrachten oppakt en uitvoert, van modelwerk tot het toegankelijk maken van de uitkomsten. Je werkt direct met de opdrachtgever en bent inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk van begin tot eind.

Wat ga je doen: - Je voert hydrologische modelstudies en scenario-analyses uit met onverzadigde zone modellen zoals SWAP en Hydrus inclusief de bijbehorende Python-toolchain, kalibratie, batch scenario's en interpretatie van hydrologische statistieken.
- Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt reproduceerbare Python-pipelines (pandas, geopandas, rasterio) die op meerdere rekeneenheden tegelijk kunnen draaien.
- Je bouwt en onderhoudt de data- en webcomponenten waarmee modeluitkomsten toegankelijk worden voor opdrachtgevers, backend (Flask, PostgreSQL/PostGIS), eenvoudige REST API's en frontend-visualisatie (Leaflet, Chart.js).
- Je verwerkt landelijke geodata (BRO, AHN, bodemkaart, landgebruik) tot modelinvoer en visualiseert uitkomsten in kaarten en beelden voor niet-technische gebruikers.
- Je bent het aanspreekpunt gedurende de opdracht, bewaakt je eigen planning en signaleert tijdig wanneer iets buiten scope gaat of vertraging dreigt.
