title: Strategic Sourcing Manager - Electronics
description:
Strategic Sourcing Manager

Purpose of the role

  *  Developing and executing global sourcing strategies for the assigned direct materials categories (electronics)
  *  Acting as a business partner to key stakeholders in Business (Business Units, Engineering, etc.) and Operations (Product Line Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Production, Materials Management, etc.)
  *  Sustaining the Global Strategic Sourcing Operating Model and providing supply capability and capacity at best cost to support future business needs and protect brand value
  *  Applying aligned sourcing processes, sustainable supplier assessments, and development approaches to establish and actively manage a performing and regulatory-compliant supply base footprint
  *  Contributing to the enhancement of supply base performance on Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QCD)
  *  Realizing measurable value of >3% in recurring and P&L-effective cost reductions per year across the global third-party spend in the assigned categories through leveraged and benchmarked supply base management
  *  Growing and further developing a qualified and performing Best Cost Country (BCC) supply base in line with company and operations objectives, preferably in Eastern Europe, while managing a sustainable spend allocation


Responsibilities:

  *  Management of own material categories (capacity, knowledge management, performance)
  *  Accountable for contributing to global Direct Material & Supply Base Performance (QCD)
  *  Representing own direct material categories within the VAT organization
  *  Accountable for category-specific achievement of objectives related to cost optimization, supply base optimization, geographic sourcing footprint, and Best Cost Country Sourcing
  *  Providing forward-looking guidance on trends, threats, and opportunities within assigned categories (e.g., raw materials)
  *  Actively contributing to the bottom-up alignment of the Direct Materials Category Team with defined company objectives
  *  Acting as the interface to Business Units and Engineering for Strategic Sourcing activities along the PDP (IP07) process
  *  Acting as a change agent toward key stakeholders
  *  Developing category sourcing strategies using defined methods and tools
  *  Managing supplier relationships across the global supply base within assigned category scope, in alignment with category teams in Switzerland, Malaysia, and Romania
  *  Ensuring consistent application of all sourcing levers
  *  Contributing to key sourcing KPIs
  *  Assembling and actively leading category-specific and cross-functional sourcing boards
  *  Actively monitoring and conducting supply base risk assessments across assigned categories
  *  Participating in and contributing to the continuous improvement of direct material sourcing practices


Qualifications:  

  *  3-4 years of in-depth strategic and operational sourcing experience with solid knowledge of global category management
  *  Demonstrated experience with category-specific production techniques and processes
  *  Knowledge of category sourcing markets
  *  Proficiency in Office software and IT applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  *  Experience sourcing in Eastern Europe and Asia, including Best Cost Country sourcing and spend relocation activities
  *  Experience working within a global and complex organization
  *  Experience in machine building, vacuum technology, and semiconductors
  *  Experience in cross-functional and category team management (at least functional leadership)
  *  Strong interpersonal, sensitive, and empathetic communication skills with suppliers, colleagues, and internal stakeholders
  *  Strong analytical and risk-based decision-making skills with a focus on key facts
  *  Ability to achieve results through others, manage multiple priorities, set priorities effectively, and handle pressure
  *  Good communication skills in German and English; additional languages are a plus

title: Ingénieur géotechnicien confirmé
description:
Ingénieur géotechnicien confirmé H/F  
Lieu : canton de Genève \& Vaud  
Taux d’activité : 70 à 100 %  
Contrat : CDI  
Expérience requise : 5 ans minimum  
Présentation de Géocimes  
Depuis près de 30ans, Géocimes est un bureau d’études indépendant spécialisé en géologie, hydrogéologie et géotechnique. Implantée dans les régions de Genève et d’Annecy, l’entreprise intervient auprès de maîtres d’ouvrage publics et privés, de collectivités, de bureaux d’ingénieurs et d’entreprises de construction.  
Nos missions concernent notamment les fondations, les ouvrages de soutènement, les terrassements, les fouilles, la stabilité des pentes et des massifs rocheux, les eaux souterraines, les risques naturels, l’instrumentation et le suivi de travaux géotechniques.  
Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité en Suisse, nous recherchons un·e ingénieur·e géotechnicien·ne confirmé·e capable de prendre en charge des projets avec un niveau élevé d’autonomie.  
Description du poste  
Rattaché·e directement à la direction, vous assurez la gestion technique et opérationnelle de projets géotechniques, depuis l’analyse du besoin du client jusqu’au suivi des travaux.  
Vous intervenez sur des projets variés en Suisse romande et participez progressivement au développement et à la structuration de l’activité de Géocimes Suisse.  
Vos principales missions  
Analyser les demandes des clients et définir le périmètre des prestations ;  
réaliser des visites de terrain et établir les premières hypothèses géologiques et géotechniques ;  
définir et organiser les campagnes de reconnaissances : sondages, essais, prélèvements et instrumentation ;  
superviser les entreprises de sondage, les laboratoires et les intervenants spécialisés ;  
interpréter les résultats des reconnaissances et des essais géotechniques ;  
établir les modèles géologiques, hydrogéologiques et géotechniques ;  
définir les paramètres de calcul et les hypothèses de dimensionnement ;  
rédiger les rapports, notes techniques, expertises et recommandations ;  
réaliser et superviser les calculs géotechniques ;  
concevoir et dimensionner des fondations, soutènements, blindages de fouilles, ouvrages de drainage, remblais et terrassements ;  
étudier la stabilité des pentes, talus et massifs rocheux ;  
préparer les pièces techniques des dossiers d’appel d’offres ;  
analyser les offres des entreprises et participer aux séances de coordination ;  
assurer le suivi d’exécution et les contrôles de chantier ;  
mettre en oeuvre des essais et contrôles de chantier ;  
adapter les recommandations aux conditions réellement rencontrées sur le terrain ;  
assurer le suivi des délais, des heures, des budgets et de la rentabilité des affaires ;  
préparer les offres techniques et financières ;  
entretenir la relation avec les clients, mandataires, administrations et entreprises ;  
contribuer au développement commercial de l’activité ;  
participer à l’amélioration des méthodes, modèles de documents et outils internes.  
Le poste comporte une part importante de travail de terrain, de rédaction technique, de calcul et de relation client.  
Profil recherché  
Diplôme d’ingénieur en génie civil avec spécialisation en géotechnique, diplôme d’ingénieur géologue ou formation équivalente ;  
formation EPF, HES ou diplôme étranger reconnu comme équivalent ;  
au moins 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle en géotechnique ;  
expérience dans la gestion autonome de projets, de préférence au sein d’un bureau d’ingénieurs ;  
maîtrise de la mécanique des sols et des principes de géologie de l’ingénieur ;  
expérience dans le dimensionnement des fondations, soutènements, fouilles, terrassements et ouvrages géotechniques ;  
capacité à interpréter des campagnes de reconnaissances et des essais in situ ;  
bonnes connaissances des normes SIA et des Eurocodes ;  
La maîtrise de logiciels de calcul géotechnique tels que TALREN, K\-REA, LARIX est indispensable.  
excellente maîtrise du français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit ;  
bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et aptitude à produire des documents techniques clairs et argumentés ;  
permis de conduire indispensable ;  
autorisation de travail valable en Suisse.  
Sont également appréciées :  
la maîtrise d’un logiciel SIG, notamment QGIS ou ArcGIS ;  
des connaissances en hydrogéologie et en mécanique des roches ;  
une expérience en instrumentation géotechnique : piézomètres, inclinomètres et suivi de mesures ;  
une connaissance des procédures et exigences des CFF ou de l’OFROU ;  
une expérience des marchés publics et appels d’offres ;  
des compétences en pollution des sols et des eaux souterraines ;  
de bonnes connaissances en allemand oral et écrit.  
Qualités attendues  
Autonomie et sens des responsabilités ;  
rigueur technique ;  
capacité d’analyse et de synthèse ;  
organisation et respect des délais ;  
aisance sur le terrain ;  
capacité à prendre des décisions et à gérer les imprévus ;  
bon relationnel avec les clients et les entreprises ;  
capacité à travailler au sein d’une petite structure ;  
polyvalence, réactivité et esprit d’équipe ;  
intérêt pour la transmission des connaissances et l’amélioration des méthodes de travail.  
Ce que nous proposons  
Des projets variés en géologie, géotechnique, hydrogéologie et risques naturels ;  
une forte proximité avec le terrain et les chantiers ;  
une autonomie réelle dans la conduite des projets ;  
une relation directe avec les clients et la direction ;  
des circuits de décision courts ;  
la possibilité de contribuer directement au développement de Géocimes Suisse ;  
des responsabilités techniques, commerciales et organisationnelles élargies ;  
une rémunération définie selon l’expérience, les compétences, le niveau d’autonomie, et des résultats commerciaux,  
Une perspective d’évolution pouvant conduire, à terme, à la reprise de Géocimes Suisse. jpidd9e16fajm jpit0731jm jpiy26jm

The talent and dedication of our people are critical to our success. Role: Operations Specialist

Oversee end-to-end listed derivatives trade lifecycle, including trade capture, allocations, clearing, and position management.
Monitor and resolve exchange vs. books and records breaks across trades, positions, and cash.
Manage internal and external position transfers, give-ups / give-ins, and clearing broker coordination.
Support regulatory and exchange reporting requirements, including control enhancements and exception management.
Partner with PMs, trading desks, brokers, exchanges, and internal teams to ensure accurate operational support.
Drive STP improvement, process efficiency, and operational scalability across the platform.
Qualifications/Skills Required

10+ years’ experience in listed derivatives operations, trade management, clearing, and reconciliations.
Strong knowledge of exchange-traded derivatives lifecycle and post-trade controls across EMEA and as well as US markets.
Experience managing exceptions, regulatory reporting, and exchange / CCP-related operational processes.
Strong stakeholder management skills across trading, client service, compliance, brokers, and vendors.
Experience working across global teams and supporting change, migrations, and new product onboarding.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Location
Geneva, Switzerland

About Millennium
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.
Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

Meet the Team
The Portfolio Manager will support a Senior Portfolio Manager in the systematic trading of interest rate derivatives, cross-currency products, and long-dated currency derivatives across developed and emerging markets, generating high-quality risk-adjusted returns through the effective deployment of allocated Firm capital.

What You’ll Do
Formulate and implement relative value investment strategies across global fixed income and macro markets.
Manage a multi-currency, multi-product portfolio with a focus on generating strong risk-adjusted returns through disciplined risk-taking and scalable capital deployment.
Identify and execute trading opportunities across linear and non-linear rates products, including swaps, options, cross-currency instruments, sovereign rates products, and related macro instruments.
Conduct fundamental and quantitative analysis across macroeconomic, geopolitical, central bank, and market-technical factors to generate trade ideas and inform portfolio positioning.
Develop and enhance analytical infrastructure, data frameworks, and tools, including PnL analytics, PCA modelling and back testing, to support investment decision-making, portfolio construction, and risk management.
Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and external counterparties to support effective portfolio implementation, market access, and trading outcomes.
Monitor positions, exposures, liquidity, and risk limits on an ongoing basis, and optimize execution and trade efficiency on a cost-adjusted basis.
Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.

Qualifications/ Skills Required
At a minimum a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
Minimum of 10 years of experience trading global fixed income rates and macro markets (including G10 markets with a specific focus on Japan and Australia), with substantial expertise in interest rate derivatives, cross-currency products, and related relative value strategies - specifically Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), Cross-Currency Swaps (Xccy), and Bonds.
Minimum of 2–3 years of portfolio management experience managing a macro / interest rate / FX relative value investment strategy within an institutional trading environment.
Experience operating successfully in a high-performance trading environment and working collaboratively within a team of investment professionals.
Demonstrated experience managing multi-currency, multi-product portfolios across both developed and emerging markets.
Experience conducting independent research into market trends and activity across global cross-currency markets.
Strong expertise in trading and portfolio management of linear and non-linear rates products, including interest rate swaps, options, cross-currency derivatives, and sovereign fixed income instruments.
Strong analytical, mathematical, portfolio construction, and risk management skills, with the ability to evaluate complex exposures across multiple products and market regimes.
Experience building, enhancing, or applying quantitative models, risk analytics, and trading tools to support portfolio optimization and investment decision-making is essential.
Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal stakeholders, sell-side counterparties, data providers, and senior management.

title: Commissioning, Qualification & Validation Professionals – Switzerland
description:
Location: Switzerland – project locations may include Basel, Visp and other major pharmaceutical manufacturing hubs
Employment Type: Permanent and Contract Opportunities
Company: KPC International
KPC International is expanding its presence in Switzerland and is interested in speaking with experienced Commissioning, Qualification and Validation professionals for current and upcoming pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical projects.
We support major capital projects from strategy and design through commissioning, qualification, start-up and operational readiness. Opportunities may be available across both project leadership and hands-on execution roles.
Areas of Interest
We welcome applications from professionals with experience in one or more of the following areas:
•    Commissioning and Qualification leadership
•    Clean and black utilities
•    HVAC and cleanrooms
•    Drug substance and drug product manufacturing
•    Fill-finish and aseptic processing
•    Buffer and media preparation
•    CIP and SIP systems
•    Upstream and downstream process equipment
•    Laboratory and analytical equipment
•    Automation and Computer System Validation
•    Thermal mapping
•    Qualification documentation and document generation
•    Quality Assurance and validation oversight
•    KNEAT, Veeva or other electronic validation systems


Typical Responsibilities
Depending on the assignment, responsibilities may include:
•    Developing and implementing commissioning and qualification strategies
•    Preparing, reviewing and executing lifecycle documentation
•    Supporting DQ, FAT, SAT, commissioning, IQ, OQ and PQ activities
•    Reviewing URS, specifications, risk assessments and traceability matrices
•    Managing deviations, punch items and qualification close-out
•    Coordinating with engineering, quality, automation, vendors and operations teams
•    Providing technical leadership across assigned systems or workstreams
•    Supporting inspection readiness and compliance with applicable GMP requirements

Candidate Profile
We are interested in candidates who can demonstrate:
•    Experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology or other regulated manufacturing environments
•    Practical commissioning, qualification or validation experience
•    A strong understanding of GMP requirements and the project lifecycle
•    The ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and international teams
•    Strong technical documentation and communication skills
•    Professional fluency in English
German or French language skills, experience working in Switzerland and familiarity with Swiss pharmaceutical manufacturing sites would be advantageous but are not essential for every position.
Work Eligibility
Applications are welcome from candidates already authorised to work in Switzerland, EU/EFTA nationals and other experienced professionals who may require work-permit support.
Any potential work-permit or relocation requirements will be reviewed individually and will depend on the position, project location, candidate experience and applicable Swiss immigration requirements.
About KPC International
KPC International has supported pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical projects worldwide since 2001. Our teams provide specialist engineering, commissioning, qualification, validation and project delivery services from concept through start-up and operation.
We offer the opportunity to work on technically challenging projects with leading life-sciences organisations, supported by an experienced international team.
Apply
Please submit your CV together with the following information:
•    Current location
•    Swiss work authorisation or nationality
•    Availability or notice period
•    Preferred employment type
•    Relevant technical disciplines
•    Expected salary or contract rate
Applications will be reviewed against both current and upcoming opportunities in Switzerland.

Background:  
We are seeking a Research Associate to support the preclinical evaluation of novel therapies for nonmalignant hematologic disorders, including bleeding and thrombotic diseases and anemia. Working within a multidisciplinary team, you will assess efficacy, safety, and translational relevance using complementary in vivo and ex vivo approaches with preclinical animal models and human blood and plasma samples. Strong hands\-on in vivo skills including compound administration, monitoring and organ sampling

Strong experience and independence in experimental design and data analysis  
Ability to independently execute and manage in vivo and in vitro studies from start to finish  
Fluency in English

title: Human Factors Engineer
description:
Human Factors Engineer
----------------------

Roche Schweiz bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our longstanding client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a

**Human Factors Engineer**
==========================

**Background:**

Roche Diagnostics Global Customer Experience and Solution Design Team (CXSD team) is looking for a passionate Senior Human Factors Engineer to redefine Roche User Interface and Product design and transform the Healthcare industry for the better. At CXSD you will join an international group of designers that serve our purpose to bring the voice of customers to the core of Roche Diagnostics decisions by designing and enabling a seamless patient-centric experience across our portfolio of products and services. You'll be part of building design maturity for Roche with peers who are passionate, energetic, and caring in a connected, multicultural, highly motivated team.

As a Human Factors Engineer, you will play a key role in the development of the next generation of medical devices that can diagnose critical diseases. You will be responsible for leading and documenting studies aimed at providing insights for the development team to improve the design as well as to provide objective evidence that the design outputs of a certain phase in the product development life-cycle are meeting all requirements.

**The Perfect Candidate** has more than 5 years of experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management. Additionally, the person is experienced in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software, as well as in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field. Also, the person is knowledgeable of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering. Lastly, the candidate communicates fluently in English.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

* Be the voice of patients and Roche users in every product-related discussion
* Identify user profiles, tasks, hazard-related use scenarios, usability risks, and requirements
* Responsible for translating UX research insights, user needs, business requirements, and technical requirements into pleasant and efficient User Experiences
* Responsible for creating medical device usability deliverables according to IEC 62366
* Create and facilitate workshops with the product teams to gather system-level information and to coordinate the design deliverables
* Plan formative and summative usability studies and coordinate external suppliers in the process
* Prepare, maintain, and review Usability Engineering Files
* Advocate for accessibility, quality, and usability for end-users at Roche Diagnostics
* Provide guidance and mentorship to more junior designers supporting them on professional development, output, and productivity

**Must Haves:**

* Master's degree in Science, Industrial Engineering, Human Factors Engineering, or other related technical field
* Min. 5 years experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management
* Experience in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software
* Experienced in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field
* Experience collecting and analyzing physiological and behavioral data
* Experience in creating, facilitating, and analyzing workshops with customers and stakeholders
* Excellent presentation skills and ability to communicate know-how, experiences, ideas, solutions, and deliverables effectively and persuasively
* Knowledge of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering
* Fluency in English. Other languages are always a big plus

**What is offered:**

* A chance to contribute to one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies
* Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting zones
* Central location with motorway connection and train station nearby
* Varied work profile
* Home office possibility
* Training opportunities through temptraining
* Collaboration in a dynamic and motivated team
* Good remuneration

You are welcome to send your complete application documents to Mr. Severin Räfle.

Chemistry Pharma Pharmacy Diagnostics Zug Lucerne Full-time Research Laboratory

Aider la fille à se déplacer, avec ses moyens auxiliaires, en classe, dans les couloirs, et lors des récréations.  
Aider la fille à accéder à l’école lors de son arrivée et la raccompagner auprès du/de la chauffeur.euse chargé.e de son retour à la  maison.

Veiller au confort de la fille durant la journée et proposer des adaptations en collaboration avec les enseignants, la direction de l’école, les parents ou toute personne responsible.
Savoir réaliser les gestes appropriés selon le handicap de la fille (toilettes, repas, etc.).
Accompagner la fille lors d’éventuelle sorties scolaires, faciliter sa participation et s’assurer que les circonstances soient adaptées pour la fille.

Soutien dans les activités scolaires (exception faite des tâches pédagogiques qui sont de la responsabilité des enseignants):

Expliquer à nouveau les consignes données par l’enseigant.e et s’assurer de leur bonne compréhension;
Soutenir la compréhension des enseignements donnés en les répétant ou en les reformulant et s’assurer de leur bonne compréhension;
Suivre la fille dans la réalisation des exercices donnés, écrire pour la fille ce qu’elle formule par oral ou l’aider à utiliser un moyen auxiliaire (ordinateur) de manière à ce qu’elle puisse suivre le rythme de la classe ou le rythme spécifiquement adapté pour elle (temps supplémentaire) qui lui permettra d’accomplir la tâche demandée;
Accompagner la fille de la même manière dans les activités de groupe proposées par l’enseignant/e.

Aide pour la participation à la vie sociale en milieu scolaire:

Faciliter les interactions sociales de la fille au sein de la classe, durant les récréations, lors de sorties ou d’activités spécifiques.

Communiquer et collaborer avec les enseignants, les responsables du suivi des élèves, les parents ou la direction de l’école afin de s’assurer que la fille puisse être intégrée au mieux à la vie scolaire et que ses apprentissages se fassent dans les meilleures conditions.
Se coordonner avec les enseignants sur le programme et les objectifs à atteindre;proposer le cas échéant des aménagements spécifiques;
participer aux séances de réseaux pour partager son expérience au quotidien avec les professionnels qui suivent la fille et les parents.

Pas de diplôme requis.
Expérience avec des personne en situation d'handicape
Grande expérience dans une domaine similaire.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Portfolio Manager  
About Millennium  
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989\. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.  
Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.  
Meet the Team  
The Portfolio Manager will support a Senior Portfolio Manager in the systematic trading of interest rate derivatives, cross\-currency products, and long\-dated currency derivatives across developed and emerging markets, generating high\-quality risk\-adjusted returns through the effective deployment of allocated Firm capital.  
What You’ll Do  
Formulate and implement relative value investment strategies across global fixed income and macro markets.  
Manage a multi\-currency, multi\-product portfolio with a focus on generating strong risk\-adjusted returns through disciplined risk\-taking and scalable capital deployment.  
Identify and execute trading opportunities across linear and non\-linear rates products, including swaps, options, cross\-currency instruments, sovereign rates products, and related macro instruments.  
Conduct fundamental and quantitative analysis across macroeconomic, geopolitical, central bank, and market\-technical factors to generate trade ideas and inform portfolio positioning.  
Develop and enhance analytical infrastructure, data frameworks, and tools, including PnL analytics, PCA modelling and back testing, to support investment decision\-making, portfolio construction, and risk management.  
Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and external counterparties to support effective portfolio implementation, market access, and trading outcomes.  
Monitor positions, exposures, liquidity, and risk limits on an ongoing basis, and optimize execution and trade efficiency on a cost\-adjusted basis.  
Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.  
Qualifications/ Skills Required  
At a minimum a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.  
Minimum of 10 years of experience trading global fixed income rates and macro markets (including G10 markets with a specific focus on Japan and Australia), with substantial expertise in interest rate derivatives, cross\-currency products, and related relative value strategies \- specifically Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), Cross\-Currency Swaps (Xccy), and Bonds.  
Minimum of 2–3 years of portfolio management experience managing a macro / interest rate / FX relative value investment strategy within an institutional trading environment.

At Accelleron, we go further. Building on the heritage of more than 100 years as ABB Turbocharging, you will join a team of true experts in an exciting international environment that share a commitment to excel, to be a trusted partner in supporting our customers in the gradual change towards sustainable industries with innovative technology, expertise and smart solutions. Through your structured, pragmatic and results-oriented approach, you will act as a trusted partner for Ops Heads, IT leads and project sponsors. You will help accelerate Accelleron's digitalization journey, strengthen operational performance and enable sustainable business growth across the value chain.

You will join the Supply & Value Chain Excellence organization in Baden, reporting to the Team Lead Value Chain Digitalization, and collaborate closely with business leadership, IT and technical experts across our value chain.

Lead complex Manufacturing and Supply Chain digitalization projects from concept through go-live and stabilization.
Initially take the lead role in the SAP EWM project, working closely with a dedicated Technical Solution Lead who provides SAP EWM and solution architecture expertise.
Manage project scope, timeline, budget, risks, governance and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate and align business stakeholders, operations, IT teams, external partners and technical experts.
Drive business process implementation, organizational change and user adoption to ensure sustainable business impact.
Lead Cutover, Migration, Go-Live and Hypercare activities where required.
Translate business and operational requirements into pragmatic and scalable solutions.
Deliver measurable business benefits and operational improvements across manufacturing, logistics and supply chain processes.
Support strategic digitalization initiatives and contribute to Accelleron's long-term Manufacturing and Supply Chain development.

**Your Background**

University degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Computer Science or a related field.
8+ years of experience leading complex projects in Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations or Digital Transformation, with excellent project and stakeholder management skills and a proven track record of successful delivery in a manufacturing environment.

title: Human Factors Engineer
description:
Human Factors Engineer
----------------------

Roche Schweiz bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our longstanding client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a

**Human Factors Engineer**
==========================

**Background:**

Roche Diagnostics Global Customer Experience and Solution Design Team (CXSD team) is looking for a passionate Senior Human Factors Engineer to redefine Roche User Interface and Product design and transform the Healthcare industry for the better. At CXSD you will join an international group of designers that serve our purpose to bring the voice of customers to the core of Roche Diagnostics decisions by designing and enabling a seamless patient-centric experience across our portfolio of products and services. You'll be part of building design maturity for Roche with peers who are passionate, energetic, and caring in a connected, multicultural, highly motivated team.

As a Human Factors Engineer, you will play a key role in the development of the next generation of medical devices that can diagnose critical diseases. You will be responsible for leading and documenting studies aimed at providing insights for the development team to improve the design as well as to provide objective evidence that the design outputs of a certain phase in the product development life-cycle are meeting all requirements.

**The Perfect Candidate** has more than 5 years of experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management. Additionally, the person is experienced in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software, as well as in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field. Also, the person is knowledgeable of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering. Lastly, the candidate communicates fluently in English.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

* Be the voice of patients and Roche users in every product-related discussion
* Identify user profiles, tasks, hazard-related use scenarios, usability risks, and requirements
* Responsible for translating UX research insights, user needs, business requirements, and technical requirements into pleasant and efficient User Experiences
* Responsible for creating medical device usability deliverables according to IEC 62366
* Create and facilitate workshops with the product teams to gather system-level information and to coordinate the design deliverables
* Plan formative and summative usability studies and coordinate external suppliers in the process
* Prepare, maintain, and review Usability Engineering Files
* Advocate for accessibility, quality, and usability for end-users at Roche Diagnostics
* Provide guidance and mentorship to more junior designers supporting them on professional development, output, and productivity

**Must Haves:**

* Master's degree in Science, Industrial Engineering, Human Factors Engineering, or other related technical field
* Min. 5 years experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management
* Experience in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software
* Experienced in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field
* Experience collecting and analyzing physiological and behavioral data
* Experience in creating, facilitating, and analyzing workshops with customers and stakeholders
* Excellent presentation skills and ability to communicate know-how, experiences, ideas, solutions, and deliverables effectively and persuasively
* Knowledge of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering
* Fluency in English. Other languages are always a big plus

**What is offered:**

* A chance to contribute to one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies
* Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting zones
* Central location with motorway connection and train station nearby
* Varied work profile
* Home office possibility
* Training opportunities through temptraining
* Collaboration in a dynamic and motivated team
* Good remuneration

You are welcome to send your complete application documents to Mr. Severin Räfle.

We are a team of Linux software engineers looking for a new team member to help us to develop and maintain Roche's inhouse Linux distribution for medical devices. The main focus of this role is to implement and maintain the next generation of the custom OS abstraction layer: a C\+\+ system daemon and a large family of plugins that expose OS capabilities over an RPC API. Besides, all team members are welcome to contribute in all areas they are interested in and feel comfortable.

Implement a comprehensive family of plugins designed to expose operating system capabilities over an RPC API.

description:

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q3 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL
Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND
Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:
“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”
Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION
The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:
Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability
Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access
Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget
Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement
Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT

Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders

Internal Leadership and Management
Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team

Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.

Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives

Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues

Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team

Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities
Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF
Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities
Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis
Survey and analyze the external access landscape

Job requirements
15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs

PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.
Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.
Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.
Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.
Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.
Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

title: Lead - Archive Management
description:
In short
We are establishing our first-ever Product Archive at our Zurich HQ and are ready to transition from vision to reality. We are looking for a visionary Product Archive Lead to spearhead this effort and drive it into its operational phase.

As an incredible self-starter with deep roots in the cultural sector, you will be the custodian of our Design heritage. With the Archive you will manage a dynamic, multi-faceted ecosystem: serving as an internal creative engine for our designers, an external-facing cultural landmark in the heart of Zurich, and a secure digital repository for our innovation. This is an opportunity to bridge our rich history with our future creative ambitions, turning our archive into a world-class inspiration hub.

Your Mission
- Establish the Center of Competence: Define and execute a holistic archive strategy. You will develop the criteria for our collection, ensuring it serves as a rigorous, authoritative, and accessible knowledge base that fuels internal research and preserves our brand DNA for the long term.
- Oversee Physical Stewardship: Manage the full lifecycle of our physical collections. This includes depot planning, organization, and qualification processes, as well as the identification and documentation of previously unrecorded object groups (shoes, textiles, accessories) and long-term conservation.
- Drive Digital & Data Infrastructure: Architect our digital repository. You will lead the implementation and integration of archive databases, ensuring seamless data flow with internal systems, and overseeing metadata standards (keywording, photo documentation) to make our history searchable and usable.
- Bridge the Past, Present, and Future: Partner with Design and Product teams to establish the archive as a functional, high-access creative engine. You will build the workflows that allow teams to search, borrow, and analyze historical product references, ensuring our past innovations directly inform and inspire current seasonal concepts.
- Collaborate on Cultural Engagement: Partner with our exhibition programming team to position the archive as a cultural landmark. You will provide the necessary historical context, exhibit curation, and material expertise to bring our brand stories to life through internal and external showcases.
- Operational Excellence: Manage the archive’s working budget, vendor relationships, and IT collaborations to ensure the archive functions as a high-performance, future-proof service.

Your story
- Heritage & Cultural Expert: You possess a deep background in managing high-value archives, heritage collections, or design museums (6-8 years of experience). You are comfortable engaging with the cultural sector and understand how to translate institutional history into a compelling modern narrative.
- Meticulous & Precise: Your approach is defined by rigorous organization. You thrive in the details of inventory management, documentation, and data standards, ensuring that every object in our care is perfectly accounted for and categorized.
- Systems Thinker: You are as comfortable with database architecture as you are with physical conservation. You can define, implement, and maintain complex systems that ensure data flows seamlessly from our past into our digital tools.
- Collaborative & Communicative: You are a natural bridge-builder. You possess the diplomacy to work across departments—from IT and Finance to Design and Marketing—and you thrive in a team environment where knowledge-sharing is the priority.
- Narrative Driven: You excel at bringing our heritage to life, transforming archival records into compelling stories. You have a unique ability to uncover the "why" behind past design decisions and can translate that historical context into actionable, relevant insights for designers working today.
- Strategic Self-Starter: You don’t wait for instructions to build a process. You are an autonomous project lead who can manage budgets, external vendors, and multi-year timelines with the agility required in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

About the Team
You will report directly to the Chief of Staff (CoS) of Design, sitting at the heart of a vibrant and diverse Design Studio that drives On’s disruptive product design across footwear, apparel, and accessories. We are a team that values creativity, curiosity, and collaboration, and we are looking for someone who shares our passion for turning the "why" of our past into the "what's next" of our future.

title: Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research
description:
Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research  
We are seeking candidates at the intersection of climate research and geography. You have expertise in concepts and theories related to climate interactions with respect to present and future environments. You have demonstrable skills in the modelling and analysis of spatio\-temporal variability of climate and associated uncertainties. You have experience in integrating climate change scenarios and model outputs in your work (e.g., for informing climate adaptation). Your research shows evidence of open and reproducible research practices, and you have an interest in communicating the results of your work to policymakers and the public. You have a developing track record in terms of research output, acquisition of third\-party funding, and teaching and mentoring.  
Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research  
Autumn 2027 (negotiable)  
As a future assistant professor, you will strengthen the scientific impact and societal role of the Department of Geography (GIUZ). You will also contribute to teaching and its further development at both Bachelor and Master levels, in both Geography and Earth Systems Science, in particular introducing our students to the fundamentals of atmosphere and climate, and teaching on topics such as climate impacts, statistical data analysis or climate extremes. You will teach in English and German, and if you have not already mastered German you are prepared to do so in the future. You will supervise Master and PhD students in topics related to your field.  
UZH sees researchers as modern leaders who conduct excellent research through their own research projects and the promotion of excellent junior researchers, who constructively work with university administration and who help to shape a future\-oriented University with innovative research\-based teaching. Situated in the open\-minded and family\-friendly city of Zurich, which combines the vibrant cultural scene of a modern European city with the convenient accessibility to its beautiful natural surroundings, UZH is well integrated in the city's community and research environment.  
UZH provides generous research support, including dedicated funds for personnel and operating expenses, and competitive start\-up packages. Additionally, the successful applicant is expected to acquire external research funding. Zurich's scientific environment encompasses a rich spectrum of diverse activities.  
The employment conditions for this position follow UZH's legal regulations and include part\-time options. UZH is an equal\-opportunities employer, and the Faculty of Science, in particular, strives to increase the percentage of women and underrepresented groups in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are particularly encouraged to apply. Care\-time interruptions are considered during the evaluation of applicants of all genders.  
What we offer  
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers.  
Location  
Department of Geography  
Information on your application  
Applicants are kindly invited to submit their applications, which should include:  
a cover letter (. 1 page)  
a Curriculum Vitae with date of submission, including teaching and supervisory track record; outreach activities; a list of acquired competitive funding, including role and amount awarded to the candidate  
a description of their research outputs relevant for this application and their importance for the field (at most five outputs, . 1 page in total)  
a research plan describing their mid\-term scientific strategy and expected impact (. 2 pages)  
a teaching reflection on their educational values, tools and methods, and their potential contribution to the curriculum development at UZH (. 1 page)  
a description of their track record and/or planned measures towards diversity, equality, inclusion, and sustainability (. 0\.5 page)  
a list of publications and other research outputs, including dataset, code, etc.  
a copy of their PhD certificate  
Please note that page limitations do not include references.  
The evaluation processes at UZH and its Faculty of Science follow the DORA recommendations for assessing research quality and impact. Applicants are thus asked to refrain from referring to non\-personal measures such as impact factors.  
Please upload your application to by 31 August 2026\. The interviews will take place on 05 and 06 November 2026\.  
For further information, please contact Prof. Dr. Ross Purves ([Write an email](<>)).

title: Research Engineer - Nanofabrication 80-100%
description:
Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication 80\-100%  
The Institute PSI is the largest research institute for natural and engineering sciences within Switzerland. We perform cutting\-edge research in the fields of future technologies, energy and climate, health innovation and fundamentals of nature. By performing fundamental and applied research, we work on sustainable solutions for major challenges facing society, science and economy. PSI is committed to the training of future generations. Therefore, about one quarter of our staff are post\-docs, post\-graduates or apprentices. Altogether, PSI employs 2300 people.  
Enable cutting\-edge research through world\-class nanofabrication infrastructure  
The Nanotechnology Group at the Institute (PSI) is looking for a motivated Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication to support the operation and continuous development of the PICO (Park Innovaare Cleanroom for Optics and Innovation) facility.  
This interdisciplinary position combines hands\-on cleanroom work, software development, scientific instrumentation, and research infrastructure management. Approximately half of your time will be spent working in the cleanroom, while the other half will focus on developing and maintaining the digital infrastructure that enables efficient operation of the facility.  
Rather than supporting a single research project, you will help build and continuously improve the infrastructure that enables hundreds of researchers from academia and industry to perform world\-class science.  
Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication 80\-100%  
Your tasks  
Develop and optimize nanofabrication processes with a focus on direct\-write laser lithography and wet chemical processing  
Become the technical expert and equipment owner for the DWL lithography systems and additional cleanroom equipment, including commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and user support  
Develop, improve, and maintain the software infrastructure supporting cleanroom operation, including the time\-tracking system used for facility access management and billing, process database and PICO website  
Provide technical and administrative support to cleanroom users, organize user training, and contribute to a positive user experience within an international research environment  
Ensure accurate documentation, facility usage tracking, and invoicing according to the requirements of different funding agencies  
Diagnose technical problems on laboratory equipment and, whenever feasible, repair electronic and mechanical issues  
Support collaborative R\&D projects with PSI research groups as well as academic and industrial partners  
Contribute to the continuous improvement of the PICO cleanroom infrastructure and its digital ecosystem  
Your profile  
We are looking for a person who enjoys building reliable research infrastructure and continuously improving laboratory operations. Success in this position requires curiosity, technical versatility, and a systematic way of working.  
A Master's degree (MSc) or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Microengineering, Nanotechnology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline  
Enthusiasm for combining cleanroom work with software development, scientific instrumentation, and research infrastructure  
Experience programming in and an interest in developing scientific software. Experience with PHP, databases, web technologies, or software automation is an advantage  
A structured, systematic, and detail\-oriented working style. You enjoy maintaining accurate documentation and organizing operational processes such as facility usage tracking and invoicing  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, ideally with experience diagnosing and/or repairing laboratory or electronic equipment  
Excellent communication skills and a service\-oriented mindset. You enjoy working with researchers from diverse scientific backgrounds and helping them succeed  
Experience with cleanroom technologies is required, direct\-write lithography, or semiconductor processing is a strong advantage  
Excellent command of English. German language skills are an advantage  
We offer  
A highly interdisciplinary role combining nanofabrication, software engineering, scientific instrumentation, and research infrastructure  
The opportunity to become the technical expert for state\-of\-the\-art direct\-write laser lithography systems and other advanced cleanroom equipment  
A modern cleanroom facility supporting leading\-edge research in nanotechnology, quantum technologies, photonics, microfabrication, and advanced materials  
Collaboration with internationally recognized researchers and industrial partners  
A stimulating working environment with a high degree of independence, responsibility, and opportunities for professional development  
Competitive employment conditions at one of Europe's leading multidisciplinary research institutes  
If you enjoy combining engineering, software development, cleanroom work, and user interaction, and would like to help build the research infrastructure that enables tomorrow's scientific breakthroughs, we look forward to receiving your application.

The position ensures that all vendor delivered services meet the AO's expectations in quality, security, cost efficiency, compliance, and performance.  
The role collaborates closely with Procurement, Security, IT Architecture, Infrastructure, IT Business Applications, Service Desk, and key business stakeholders to guarantee end to end service continuity and a professional vendor ecosystem.

Vendor \& Third\-Party Management (60% of the role):  
Develop, implement, and continuously improve the AO's vendor management framework, including policies, governance, and lifecycle management  
Drive vendor consolidation  
Strongly support changing vendors delivery method from a staff augmentation to a managed work approach  
Lead the full lifecycle: sourcing, evaluation, onboarding, contracting, performance management, productivity, renewal, and offboarding  
Ensure compliance with AO information security and regulatory requirements, including periodic vendor audits and assessments  
Contract, Commercial \& Financial Management  
Lead contract negotiations in cooperation with IT procurement to secure cost\-effective and high\-quality services  
Manage vendor\-related budgeting, financial forecasting, spend tracking, and cost optimization  
Ensure alignment of all contracts with AO legal, procurement, and compliance requirements  
SLA, KPI \& Performance Management  
Define service levels, KPIs, OLAs, and performance measures for all external providers  
Conduct structured performance reviews with vendors, including escalations and corrective action plans  
Ensure transparency of service quality through standardized reporting and dashboards  
Risk, Security \& Compliance

Work with the IT Security Manager to manage vendor\-related risk assessments, security audits, and continuous improvement measures  
Maintain a vendor risk register and ensure mitigation actions are implemented  
Operations and Management Coordination (20% of role):  
Team \& Operational Coordination  
Coordinate administrative and organizational activities within IT, maintain documentation and governance materials, and support planning of meetings, presentations, workshops, and reports.  
Management Support  
Serve as a central coordination point for IT leadership, stakeholders, and partners; track initiative progress, highlight priorities and risks, and prepare briefings to support decision\-making.  
Partner \& Stakeholder Management  
Assist with partner coordination, meeting documentation, and action tracking while ensuring clear communication and strong relationships with vendors and service providers.  
Operational Improvement  
Identify workflow inefficiencies, propose improvements, support digital tools and automation, and help monitor costs and performance to drive operational excellence.  
Main Requirements  
Educational Requirements  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field  
Additional training in negotiation, contract law, or financial management is an advantage  
Core Skills / Competencies  
Strong expertise in IT vendor management, IT contract negotiation, and commercial governance  
Excellent knowledge of IT service management frameworks (ITIL), SLA models, and performance management  
Solid understanding of IT security, IAM, compliance standards, and risk management  
Experience with Mircrosoft license models (Azure, MS365\)  
Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills  
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex operational and commercial data  
Ability to manage multi vendor environments and resolve escalations in a structured and collaborative manner  
Job Experience  
Minimum 4 years of experience in IT vendor management  
Proven experience managing complex vendor ecosystems, including cloud, managed services, workplace, and infrastructure providers.  
Experience in audit driven environments and security sensitive operational contexts.
